jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co\-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform. Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross\-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win\-win\-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross\-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams. What You'll Be Doing Co\-Marketing Execution Support and execute partner co\-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in\-product placements, and live events. Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time\-to\-launch across partners. Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review. Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables. Cross\-Functional Program Coordination Provide day\-to\-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always\-on promotions running smoothly. Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner\-facing programs. Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders. Maintain intake and request\-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently. Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification). Help coordinate partner workshops, innovation days, QBR presentations, and industry summits, using established frameworks and templates. Reporting \& Optimization Track campaign performance against business KPIs — including revenue supported, daily account linked players (DALP), and Commerce GMV — and help synthesize insights for the team. Help maintain a partner marketing roadmap that shows program activity and status for cross\-functional visibility. Flag recurring friction points (e.g., one\-off approval requests, low\-priority asks) to help the team improve processes over time. What you should have Experience 5–6 years of experience in partner marketing, co\-marketing, marketing operations, or program/project coordination — ideally in a tech, gaming, or platform company. Experience supporting cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting. Some experience working directly with external partners or clients in a marketing capacity. Skills Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks. Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others. Detail\-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage an asset tracker or partner approval request end\-to\-end. Comfortable working in fast\-paced environments with shifting priorities. Good analytical instincts — comfortable pulling data and connecting program activity to business metrics with guidance. Tools Proficiency in project management and workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Salesforce, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude / AI). Familiarity with cross\-functional marketing operations, including intake and approval workflows. Experience with presentation\-heavy environments (Google Slides / PowerPoint) — you'll frequently build and review partner\-facing materials. Bonus Points Experience in the gaming industry or with game developer partnerships. Background in or exposure to developer marketing, platform marketing, or B2B marketing. Familiarity with co\-marketing in a deal context — where marketing is part of a larger commercial negotiation. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $148,000 to $166,500 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.Why Discord?Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of persona

jobs.title: CAP-CT Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves analytical studies on a variety of policies, projects, programs and issues in support of a function, research initiative, program and / or organizational unit, or in research of new or changing systems and programs. Assists in policy and program planning, development, administration, management and implementation; interprets, monitors and analyzes information regarding policies and procedures and provides consultative services to department administrators and other stakeholders.


**Generic Scope**

Professional who applies acquired job skills, policies, and procedures to complete substantive assignments / projects / tasks of moderate scope and complexity; exercises judgment within defined guidelines and practices to determine appropriate action.


**Custom Scope**

The UCSF Division of Geriatrics seeks to recruit a full\-time **Program Coordinator** to support the implementation and operational ownership of a Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) funded program, Caregivers as Partners in Care Teams (CAP\-CT). This position reports to the Program Director and supports/leads a wide\-range of project operations and coordination tasks. The Program Coordinator will perform a broad range of duties that will require analytical, organizational, communication, technical, and coordination skills. Specific duties include: coordinating and maintaining project timelines and deliverables, assisting with researching and applying relevant policies, data collection, management, analyses and reporting, preparing and updating program materials/protocols/procedures, coordinating meeting schedules/agendas/minutes, drafting and updating documents, making program\-related purchases and submitting expense reports, conducting literature searches/reviews, and supporting manuscript preparation/scholarly dissemination. The Program Coordinator will additionally function as a subject matter expert and provide oversight and direction on learning management systems, manage digital education platforms, CE/CME accreditation coordination, analytics reporting, marketing communications, website management, and operational support across multiple projects and conferences. This position requires the ability to be proactive, resourceful and efficient, with a high level of flexibility. An ideal candidate will be able to work independently with minimal supervision, balances multiple competing priorities at any given time, and is intellectually curious, willing to learn new skills and a problem\-solver. The Program Coordinator may be required to provide the same level of support across projects/programs where there is a need.


**Department Overview**

The Division of Geriatrics’ work is grounded in a deep commitment to and respect for older persons from diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. We are specialists in aging. Our expertise is in optimizing the health of older individuals. We work in the community and on virtually every UCSF campus – Parnassus, San Francisco VA Health Care System, Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital, Mission Bay, and UCSF Center for Geriatric Care. The Division has over 130 employees including faculty, volunteer clinical faculty, fellows, staff, student interns and volunteers. We are deeply committed to, and will champion, diversity, equity and inclusion as our core mission. We will nurture and grow a culture in which everyone from all backgrounds is welcomed, supported, respected, and valued!


  
**Required Qualifications**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience.
* Working knowledge of common organization\- or research\-specific and other computer application programs.
* Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Proficient in ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Experience in using Qualtrics/REDCap/other surveying platforms.
* Proficient in MS Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.)
* Proficient with Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Learning Management System (LMS).
* Experience working with consumers of educational courses/academic institutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in public health or research administration, e.g. working on state contracts, NIH programs, or working in an academic institution.
* Previous experience using project management tools and software, website management and managing social media platforms.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

jobs.title: Food Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Food Program Coordinator

**Organization:** Daly City Partnership (DCP)

**Reports To:** Director of COVE

**Supervises:** \~20 Volunteers; provides secondary supervision and support when the primary supervisor is unavailable

**Salary Range:** Grade 7 ($28/hr \- $31/hr)

**FLSA Status:** Full\-Time \| 40 hrs/week

**About Daly City Peninsula Partnership Collaborative**

Daly City Partnership is a 501(c)(3\) non\-profit organization dedicated to creating transformative change in Northern San Mateo County. We provide comprehensive, multi\-generational services that empower children, families, and older adults to overcome challenges and promote community advancement. Our vision is a thriving community where everyone is empowered to reach their full potential, driven by our core values of Community, Responsibility, Determination, and Compassion. 

**Position Overview**

The Food Distribution Coordinator oversees the daily operations of DCP’s food programs. This includes organizing weekly food distributions, managing volunteers, maintaining inventory, and submitting reports. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, dependable, and enjoys engaging with both the community and volunteers in a fast\-paced environment. Supervised by the Director of COVE. 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 1–2 years' experience in a leadership role, program coordination or volunteer management
* Valid California driver’s license and a driving record that meets the organization’s insurance requirements
* Must maintain a clean and insurable driving record throughout employment.
* Experience working with diverse populations
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Familiar with Microsoft Office

**Preferred Qualifications (In Addition To Those Above)**

* Bilingual in Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin
* Experience in food security or nonprofit programs

**Operational Responsibilities**

* Act as the lead coordinator for the grocery rescue program and Project Dash, managing logistics, scheduling, and partner communication.
* Safely drive the organization's van to execute grocery rescue pickups and perform Project Dash home deliveries (up to twice a week).
* Coordinate daily operations for Project Dash and satellite site distributions.
* Serve as operational support to the main food distribution program as needed.
* Train and supervise volunteers, ensuring compliance with safety and civil rights protocols
* Maintain volunteer records, monitor performance, and foster an inclusive team environment
* Support clients during distribution and connect them to additional resources as needed
* Utilize digital platforms for communication, scheduling, and tracking volunteer engagement

**Ability to:**

* Follow food safety and civil rights regulations
* De\-escalate and resolve client concerns
* Keep confidentiality of client and volunteer information
* Be able to lift up to 50 pounds, occasionally.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must perform a background check and driving record check

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Paid Holidays, Sick leave
* 403 (b) plan
* Ongoing training, growth \& advancement opportunities

Employment with Daly City Partnership is "at\-will." Either the employee or the organization may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment. 

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter and complete all questions and assessments on Indeed.

***Join a caring and dedicated team of co\-workers and volunteers who take great pride and joy in helping members of our community succeed and thrive!***

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $28\.00 \- $31\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 403(b)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Spanish, Tagalog, Cantonese, or Mandarin  (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: OCIP Workers Compensation Program Coordinator, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Lead Case Manager
jobs.description:
**About Lao Family Community Development, Inc.**


Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD) is a community\-based non\-profit organization established in Richmond, Contra Costa County, California, in 1980\. Since then, LFCD has expanded its operations to Alameda and Sacramento counties with its headquarters located in Oakland, California.


LFCD delivers programs and services from seven locations in more than 35 languages. The organization provides community development, affordable real estate, workforce development, education, and human services that primarily support low\-income individuals and families, refugees, immigrants, transitional\-age youth, seniors, individuals with disabilities, and other underserved populations.

**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the program supervisor, this position will serve low\-income Workforce Innovation Opportunity Act (WIOA) participants, CalWorks LEP participants, and CSBG participants to gain job placements, as well as manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal\-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non\-clinical needs.


The Lead Case Manager is responsible for overseeing the Contra Costa County Workforce Development Board (CCCWDB) WIOA Employment Services case management services, ensuring high\-quality workforce services delivery, preparing the reports, ensuring compliance with program requirements and successful participant outcomes.


This position is responsible for interfacing with local employers and training providers, external organizations, and the internal LFCD department, especially the America’s Job Center of California (AJCC) and Business Centers. The position’s duties include lead the project, organize quarterly job fair, outreach recruitment for employers and job seekers, provide orientation, intake\-assessment, set up Individual Employment Plan (IEP), case management, On the Job Training (OJT), Individual Training Account (ITA) / Vocational Training counseling, job placement, retention services, assessing the participants health condition and coordinating care. Program activities and strategies include long\-term career advancement for each participant; understanding the hiring and business development needs of each employer; the policy and compliance requirements of funders; and the many subtle factors that can influence each individual’s ability to thrive and advance in the workplace. Knowledge of the human services needs of the local job market is a plus. This position is required to rotate at LFCD AJCC location and reports to the Program Supervisor.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage three primary projects: CCCWDB WIOA, CalWorks LEP, and CSBG Programs.
* Conduct individual assessments to develop personalized care management and employment plans, addressing physical health, mental health, substance use disorders, oral health, social determinants of health, career goals, and job placement strategies.
* Provide outreach and engagement in the community, attending resource fairs, distributing promotional materials, and coordinating referrals to social services, workforce programs, and healthcare providers to achieve participants’ care and employment goals.
* Lead workshops, job orientation sessions, one\-on\-one and small group counseling, and educational programs focused on job readiness, healthy living, independence, and goal setting.
* Assist participants in developing resumes, cover letters, and employment plans while providing labor market insights, job referrals, job fairs, interview coaching, and job placements.
* Provide intensive services to participants including: intake assessment, certify and obtain supportive documents for enrollments into the program; develop Individual Employment Plan (IEP), identify career goals, prepare assessment, and make appropriate referrals; provide 12 months of job retention services.
* Communicate with training providers and ensure ITA request is submitted on a timely manner; perform tracking of participants, input data, daily log, monthly case notes, and all other activities in CalJOBS system and internal tracking form.
* Community Support: Services to address members’ health\-related social needs to improve health and well\-being.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, provide appointment reminders, arrange transportation, accompany clients to critical appointments and job interviews, and address barriers to participation in care and employment programs.
* Maintain strong networks with employers, community stakeholders, and service providers, ensuring program participants have access to career opportunities and supportive services.
* Organize quarterly job fair.
* Identify job opportunities with reasonable wages and benefits, conduct employer orientations, maintain employer relationships, and facilitate On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) opportunities.
* Assist participants in accessing benefits such as Social Security Insurance (SSI), CalFresh, cash aid, workforce training programs, and other social services, guiding them through required documentation.
* Provide transitional care and employment retention support, including job tracking, follow\-up services, and employer engagement to ensure job stability.
* Develop and maintain detailed knowledge of programs such as WIOA, CalWorks LEP, CSBG, and CalAIM Program, leveraging partnerships to enhance participant outcomes.
* Maintain accurate case files and documentation, including participant enrollments, progress tracking, eligibility verification, and compliance with HIPAA and workforce development regulations.
* Collaborate with local colleges, career centers, and training providers to facilitate participant enrollment in workforce programs and ensure timely processing of training approvals.
* Communicate with county and workforce development staff to ensure compliance with program requirements, eligibility verification, and time

jobs.title: Assistant Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Assistant Operations Manager  

**Classification:** Exempt  

**Location:** Redwood City, Ca  

**Reports To:** Operations Manager

**Pay Range:** $75,000\-$90,000  

  

**About the Company:**  

  

For 100 years and four generations of Hayward family leadership, Hayward Lumber has been committed to meeting and exceeding the needs of builders. Beyond full\-service lumberyards, we offer window, door and cabinet design centers, pro\-oriented hardware stores, and innovative building solutions designed to save time and money. Hayward Lumber is a family\-oriented company that treats every employee as such. Our average tenure companywide is over 10 years and we pride ourselves in creating an environment in which you can learn, grow, and prosper. Hayward Lumber provides a competitive compensation structure, as well as a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401K, and paid time off including vacation, holiday, and sick leave. Learn more at www.haywardlumber.com  

  

**Mission:**  

  

Hayward will be the most dependable supplier of products, services and solutions to the construction market, as it has been since 1919\.  

  

**Position Summary:**


The Assistant Operations Manager works closely with the Operations Manager and is responsible for providing day\-to\-day operational leadership, ensuring efficient processes, effective resource allocation, high standards of safety and quality and excellent customer service. This role involves supervising and developing staff, managing inventory systems and workflows, coordinating fleet and property maintenance, and driving continuous improvement across all operational functions. The ideal candidate is highly organized, a skilled problem\-solver, and adept at managing complex operations in the lumber and building materials industry.

* Work closely with the Operations Manager to implement operational strategies, policies, and procedures.
* Assist in planning and coordinating daily operations, ensuring that production schedules, inventory levels, and staffing requirements are met.
* Assist in developing staff performance through training, coaching, scheduling, and handling disciplinary actions as needed.
* Coordinate staffing needs, approve time off, and create/maintain schedules for all yard and retail personnel.
* Monitor work processes, schedules, and workflows to ensure maximum efficiency across operations and address any operational challenges or bottlenecks promptly.
* Utilizes various Bistrack dashboards to track operational KPIs and ensure Hayward processes are being consistently followed
* Build and maintain a strong team environment by working collaboratively with sellers, managers, and other stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain a 30\-60\-90\-day operational plan, updating it weekly to reflect changing priorities.
* Coordinate the use of materials handling equipment such as forklifts, saws, and trucks to optimize operations.
* Work closely with the Operations Manager to schedule fleet and vehicle maintenance, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.
* Work closely with Operations Manager to administer location maintenance and repair programs for buildings, property, equipment, and vehicles.
* Gain a comprehensive understanding of the inventory control system (BisTrack) to utilize its capabilities, reporting functions, and documentation effectively (training provided).
* Learn and maintain knowledge of inventory products, including Simpson, Feeney, composite decking, and engineered wood products (EWP).
* Assist in maintaining optimal inventory levels to support production and fulfill customer orders efficiently.
* Coordinate with procurement and logistics to ensure the timely availability of materials and resources.
* Process special orders, purchase orders (POs), and manage price records using the price matrix.
* Perform retail store operations, including processing transactions on the cash register, balancing cash at the end of the day, and ensuring customer satisfaction.
* Ensure all customer orders, including special orders, are assembled accurately and shipped in a timely manner.
* Uphold all company policies and procedures, including OSHA, health standards, and safety regulations.
* Enforce safety protocols, provide safety training, and promote a culture of workplace safety.
* Coordinate loss control activities, including fire, theft, and fleet safety programs.
* Monitor time and production records, making data\-driven suggestions to improve team efficiency and providing feedback to the Operations Manager.
* Assist in identifying opportunities for operational improvements and support the implementation of lean processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collect and analyze data to evaluate efficiency and effectiveness and suggest solutions for enhanced productivity.

This job supervises others, below are some of the titles of the positions managed and the number of employees supervise.




* Load Builder
* Yard Retail Clerk
* Driver
* Yard Dispatcher
* Cashier
* Contractor Support
* Outside Sales Representatives

  

  

Total employees supervised anywhere from 1 to 25 employees. Branch management staffing needs may require overseeing store employees and sales reps.

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

  

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.\-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high\-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

  

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI\-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will own the technical and commercial vetting that turns a raw deal into a fundable project — the work that separates a defensible capacity commitment from an inflated one. When a partner asks Crux to guarantee an eight\- or nine\-figure sum, you're the one who tests that number against schedule, equipment composition, and real construction cost before it goes to leadership. Reporting into the Chief Program Manager's organization, you will sit at the interface between Data Center Construction, Energy, MEP, and Finance, making sure every project in the active portfolio is executed against the numbers it was approved on — and flagging it immediately when it isn't.

**In this role, you will:**

* Vet the technical and commercial terms of new capacity deals — schedule, equipment cost, equipment composition — before they're recommended to leadership, right\-sizing commitments rather than defaulting to the number a partner asks for.
* Track every live data center project in the portfolio against its approved cost and schedule baseline, and own the process for flagging and escalating variance early.
* Partner with Data Center Construction, Energy, and MEP Systems teams to translate field\-level execution status into Finance\-ready program reporting.
* Own the interface between build\-side execution and the cost and margin model of record — your data is what Finance's models are actually built on.
* Run the change\-control process for scope, schedule, or cost changes on active projects, with sign\-off gates that keep Finance and Development aligned in real time.
* Build and maintain the tools that make deal vetting fast and repeatable — this cannot be a one\-off analysis redone from scratch on every deal.
* Default to AI\-agentic workflows for cost/schedule reconciliation and variance tracking, rather than adding headcount to keep up with portfolio growth.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Deal\-vetting framework (schedule, equipment cost, composition) is documented and applied to at least one live negotiation.
* Portfolio cost/schedule tracking is live for the current active project set.

**After 6 months:**

* Variance escalation process is running with a documented track record of catching at\-risk projects before they slip.
* Finance's cost and margin model of record is being fed directly from your tracking, not reconstructed separately.

**After 1 year:**

* Deal\-vetting and portfolio\-tracking functions run as a repeatable system others can execute against, not a one\-person effort.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 8\+ years in data center construction, capital projects, or infrastructure delivery with direct P\&L, cost, or schedule ownership.
* Demonstrated experience vetting or negotiating capacity/commercial terms against real technical and cost data, not top\-down assumptions.
* Comfortable moving fluently across finance, construction, and technology — this is not a single\-lane specialist seat.

**Attributes**

* “$900M is the ask” is a hypothesis until the equipment and schedule say otherwise — you test the number before you defend it.
* You bring bad news first, unprompted, and own the result — hierarchy doesn't intimidate you and you don't intimidate easily either.

**Mindset**

* High tolerance for ambiguity. The portfolio will outgrow whatever process exists today, and you build the next version rather than waiting for one.
* AI\-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents — or committed to becoming so quickly — and you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (preferred, not required)**

* Background in data center construction, controllership, or capital\-projects finance specialized in the build environment.
* Experience with direct\-to\-chip liquid cooling, Level 5/IST commissioning, or other GW\-scale data center technical scope.
* Neocloud or hyperscaler experience (CoreWeave, Nebius, Nscale, Lambda, Google, AWS, Meta, Microsoft) in a program or delivery management capacity.
* Formal cost engineering, quantity surveying, or construction finance credential.

**Salary Range Information**


The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Crux**

* We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Company\-paid life insurance and disability
* Full suite of other optional benefits
* 401(k) Plan with 4% company match (USA employees)

The Operations Supervisor oversees the daily activities of an operational unit. Maintains workflow, staffing and scheduling to achieve targeted operational and financial results. Schedule and manage workers in operations or plant to ensure efficiency. He or she determines the labor hours needed and quantity of certain items to be received, stocked, picked, inventoried, cleaned, and/or shipped.

* Provide managers, peers, and subordinates with information about quality, safety delivery, cost, and morale

* Will oversee anywhere from 1 to 25 hourly associates
* Work with strict demands and budgets, so that they can set production schedules
* Monitor activity and make sure that daily quotas are met by keeping workers on task and informed of procedural changes. If production falls behind for any reason, a supervisor can determine the best ways to get back on schedule

* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

* Experience with process improvement methodologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness
* Understanding of RF scanners and standardized processes
* Knowledge of picking, receiving, and shipping processes, hands on experience preferred
* Excellent verbal, interpersonal and written communication skills
* Excellent time management skills
* A strong sense of urgency and drive to succeed

* Demonstrates ability to interact well with others and follow instructions
* Flexibility and ability to adjust to sudden changes in operational goals

* Familiarity with Agile, Arena, and other PLM systems
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite

* Basic math \& writing skills.

* Minimum of 2 years of supervisory experience

* Forklift certification a plus: sit\-down \& stand\-up

jobs.title: Landscape Architect / Project Manager
jobs.description:
Landscape Architect/Project Manager

This role is in\-office in San Francisco, with the option to work at home 1 day/week after a positive 6\-month review.

**About Fletcher Studio**

Fletcher Studio is an agile, close\-knit team working to create satisfying and sustainable landscapes, urban spaces, and living infrastructures. We believe design matters, and that people deserve to find value, meaning, and possibility in the places they encounter and occupy. We work with city makers, communities, and other visionaries to realize evocative and appropriate concepts, designed and constructed to ensure social vitality and integrity. We leverage technology to work faster and smarter—people, ideas, and culture drive our process. Our small studio offers opportunities for leadership and mentorship.

**About the Role**

This role of Landscape Architect / Project Manager is a new addition to the team. This position will lead complex landscape architecture projects from conceptual design through construction. This is a hands\-on leadership role for a landscape architect who combines strong design sensibility with the technical expertise and project management skills necessary to translate ambitious ideas into successfully built work.

Working closely with Studio Principals, the Landscape Architect / Project Manager will lead project teams; establish and implement design objectives; manage project schedules, budgets, and deliverables; coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders; and oversee the preparation of high\-quality construction documentation and construction administration.

An important initial assignment for this role will be managing Fletcher Studio’s contract, including the implementation of two large 3–5\-acre parks, Meadow Park and Neighborhood Park. For a period of at least 24 months, the position will require a regular part\-time presence in Anaheim, Orange County, to provide on\-site project management, coordination, and construction administration for the OCVIBE project. The specific balance of on\-site and remote work is still being determined, but will include weekly OAC meetings, twice\-monthly site visits, and preparation of field reports.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable contributing to design discussions, directing production and technical documentation, managing client and consultant relationships, and resolving issues in the field. The role will also help strengthen the studio through mentorship, quality control, technical innovation, and staff development.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Design \& Project Leadership**

* Lead landscape architecture projects through all phases, from site analysis and conceptual design through design development, construction documentation, permitting, and construction administration.
* Develop and advance innovative, contextually responsive design solutions that balance creativity, sustainability, functionality, constructability, budget, and client objectives.
* Work closely with Studio Principals to establish and maintain the design direction and objectives of assigned projects.
* Lead and coordinate project teams to deliver high\-quality work consistent with Fletcher Studio's design standards.
* Conduct site analysis and research addressing ecological, cultural, technical, and contextual considerations.
* Contribute significantly to the design direction of projects of varying complexity, type, and scale.

**Project Management**

* Manage multiple projects concurrently, establishing priorities and maintaining project schedules, budgets, staffing plans, resources, and deliverables.
* Serve as the project manager for Fletcher Studio’s OCVIBE contract, including regular on\-site coordination and project oversight in Orange County for at least the 24 months of the assignment.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, consultants, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary consultant teams and maintain strong working relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor project scope, schedule, budget, and staffing and proactively identify and resolve issues that could affect successful delivery. Manage monthly client invoicing with bookkeeper and administrative staff.
* Lead client and stakeholder meetings, presentations, and project coordination efforts.
* Communicate project status, decisions, risks, and next steps clearly to Studio Principals and project teams.

**Technical Documentation \& Quality Control**

* Lead and oversee the development of detailed construction drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Ensure that drawings and project documents are accurate, coordinated, comprehensive, constructible, and consistent with design intent.
* Review project documentation for compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, design standards, and technical specifications.

**Please note:** We will consider both Hybrid and Remote candidates for this role.


The Digital Accessibility Program Manager serves as the operational and subject matter backbone to the Office of Digital Accessibility’s service delivery. This role owns the day\-to\-day functioning of the digital accessibility program in managing the service portfolio, conducting accessibility evaluations, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of accessibility reviews from team members, engaging directly with campus clients on complex compliance challenges, and tracking program performance. The Digital Accessibility Program Manager reports to the Director for the Office of Digital Accessibility.


The ideal candidate brings both digital accessibility expertise and strong program management skills, serving as a critical bridge between technical staff and Stanford clients by translating findings, balancing competing priorities, and ensuring clients leave every engagement with clear, actionable guidance. They are equally comfortable guiding a campus web team through a remediation roadmap, reviewing an engineer's audit report for accuracy and completeness, and prioritizing and managing competing tasks with concurrent deadlines.


**Core Duties:**

**Program Management:**

* Manage the digital accessibility service intake pipeline by triaging incoming requests, assigning work, tracking progress, and ensuring reviews and consultations are completed on schedule.
* Coordinate with Office of Digital Accessibility staff on workload planning, deadline management, and service delivery priorities.
* Maintain quality standards for digital accessibility deliverables and consult with digital accessibility engineers on complex findings or edge cases requiring additional interpretation. Ensure findings are presented in a manner that is solution\-focused and actionable for both technical and non\-technical clients.
Oversee the interpretation, implementation and compliance with digital accessibility standards and regulations. Recommend actions and/or resolve complex issues with institutional partners that span organizational and university boundaries.  
* 

**Program Evaluation:**

* Evaluate how existing accessibility tools are offered and based on configuration, adoption, and use, if they are meeting program goals or when alternatives should be considered.
* Identify trends in accessibility issues across campus and surface insights that inform strategy and resource planning.
In coordination with the Director, track and maintain key performance indicators and program metrics, including service volume, review turnaround times, client satisfaction, remediation outcomes, and compliance trends.  
* 

**Planning and Analysis:**

* Under supervision of the Director, execute strategic plans for the Office of Digital Accessibility, leveraging subject matter expertise to meet regulatory and technical challenges for digital accessibility.
* Design and evolve the digital accessibility service delivery model, determining how core services (e.g., audit intake, remediation consultation, procurement review, training) are structured and delivered to improve client experiences.
Apply a creative mindset and bring the ability to think outside the box to create innovative service offerings.  
* 

**Client Management:**

* Advise clients on how accessibility requirements should be applied to specific vendor evaluations while balancing the intersection of technical standards, compliance obligations, and institutional constraints.
* Support clients on complex compliance requirements, including situations requiring creative or non\-standard solutions.
* Navigate difficult conversations with stakeholders who are resistant to or overwhelmed by accessibility requirements.
* Translate technical remediation findings into actionable guidance for non\-technical content owners, developers, and procurement staff.

  
**Core Duties** :

Bachelor’s degree and eight years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.

* Demonstrated leadership skills and ability to influence and motivate constituencies which could span multiple organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated excellent planning, organizational and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound business decisions using good business judgment and innovative and creative problem\-solving.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Launch Manager - Pharmaceuticals
jobs.description:
**Description**


**You’re driven, resourceful, and above all else – remarkably smart.**


In this role, you will support the development and execution of commercial readiness plans for new product launches. Working with our clients, you play an integral role working to support the launch planning and management efforts across a variety of assets, indications and geographies. The Launch Manager will assist established and emerging life science clients by being part of the team that brings a disciplined approach to help our customers commercialize their brands. You will:

* Facilitate regular launch readiness meetings with stakeholders, executive leadership and coordinate stakeholder support for these meetings. Communicate required tasks, updates and timelines.
* Develop a deep understanding of the market problems of various industry segments and user personas. Effectively position and communicate how the product features and the functionality create client\-based solutions.
* Track deliverables, it's risks and discrepancies across the cross\-functional launch team
* Actively support product and application launch activities including product positioning, promotional and pricing strategies, training and working with cross functional teams

**Essential Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, life science or other related field
* Minimum 2yrs experience with launch management or execution of launch (marketing, branding, project management)

**Desired Requirements:**

* PMI, CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Mgt) or PMP (Project Mgt. Professional)
* Experience in meeting facilitation and strong presentation skills


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $122,000 to $134,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, you're a part of the big picture. You will collaborate with colleagues across clinical and commercial disciplines to guide premarket development through post\-market commercial strategy. Every project is a chance to solve a new challenge, learn from your colleagues, and advance your career. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients' lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


Syneos Health has a voluntary COVID\-19 vaccination policy. We strongly encourage all employees to be fully vaccinated. Additionally, certain local governments or Syneos Health customers may have vaccine requirements that apply to some of our employees. These employees are required to submit proof of vaccination to Syneos Health and maintain compliance with these requirements.
  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

jobs.title: Product Support Manager, Shopping Product Support Excellence
jobs.description:
The application window will be open until at least September 29, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.  

  

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer\-facing role.  
* 

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting consumer or merchant\-facing e\-commerce, digital retail, visual search, or generative/agentic AI products.
* Strong investigative capabilities with proven experience translating unstructured feedback into actionable product recommendations.
* Demonstrated track record of managing competing priorities, leading cross\-functional alignment across PM/Eng/UX, and driving end\-to\-end launch readiness.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence executive cross\-functional stakeholders.

**About the job**
-----------------


We are part of Product Support Excellence within gUP (gTech Users and Products), dedicated to delivering exceptional service while advocating the consumer perspective for Google’s flagship commerce platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between billions of everyday shoppers and internal engineering teams, leveraging operational systems, active feedback loops, and cross\-functional partnerships to make online journeys more intuitive, helpful, and reliable.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  

  

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $114000 \- $163000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the dedicated support strategy lead and main point of contact for Shopping Product Management and Engineering partners across Shopping Creatives, Visual Content, and Agentic features.
* Define and execute launch readiness plans, issue taxonomy, operational workflows, and risk assessments for new shopping formats and Artificial Intelligence\-driven experiences.
* Monitor product uptake, track spikes in feedback, lead critical issue escalation management, and provide swift resolution for emerging user pain points.
* Transform raw feedback and operational data into user insights, influencing product roadmaps and feature iteration for visual shopping and agentic tools.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Product Manager, Engineering, Program Manager, User Experience Research, Trust and Safety, and Content teams to integrate the shopper into every stage of the product development lifecycle.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.description:

* Dental insurance

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Sr. Program Manager**
=======================

  

**Date:** Sep 15, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30221**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.


**Job Summary:**
----------------


We currently seek a dynamic Sr. Program Manager to provide leadership, oversight to drive, coordinate, and monitor engineering programs including scheduling, planning, product and project cost analysis, early access, and first customer shipment. This role will be heavily involved in leading the cross\-functional teams from sales, productions, and purchasing. You must have an exceptional project management and communication skills in order to succeed in this role.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------


* Frequent interface with focused key OEM customers in providing turnkey manufacturing services
* Drive day to day operations in production planning, material readiness, shortage prevention, order fulfillment, quality control and new product development related topics, to ensure meeting forecast requirements, customer satisfaction and our business growth targets
* Coordinate tasks of a cross\-functional team from Sales, Production, product management, and Purchasing Departments to deliver outstanding products and issue solutions
* Assist engineering programs including NPI, FAI and ECO related project scheduling and material planning to ensure time to market
* Analyze customer forecast demands and maintain corresponding material schedule plan to mitigate potential shortages and keep fast order fulfillments for sustaining products
* Control end of life product schedule and material disposition. Plan for post\-sale service requirements while preventing excess obsolesce from becoming an issue.
* Identify and develop strong business models and process improvement initiatives in supply chain, production and the whole product life cycle
* Special projects as assigned
**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration


* Minimum 8 years of experience in the computer/server industry


* Experiences in contract manufacturing, product development, project management, quality control, and/or procurement support; technical knowledge on material\-related and quick\-turn engineer\-to\-order environment experience.


* Proven track record of managing projects and delivering on time


* The ability to work/coordinate efficiently with cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Sales, Operations, Purchasing, and Logistics, internally and externally, to optimize business models
* Excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills. Advanced level in Excel and Power Point. Excellent presentation skills required. Experience with ERP system (SAP) preferred


* Demonstrated ability to take initiative, develop and implement new processes

  

  

Please note that this position requires regular in\-office attendance. The successful candidate is expected to be present in the office during standard working hours as determined by the company. In\-office collaboration and participation in team meetings, training sessions, and other on\-site activities are essential aspects of this role. Candidates should consider the commuting distance and be prepared to fulfill their responsibilities in the designated office location.


**Salary Range**
----------------


$120,000 \- $154,000


The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.
