It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Project Manager 2
jobs.description:
Convergint is looking for a full\-time, enthusiastic, results driven and forward\-thinking Project Manager to join our amazing culture. In this role, you will ensure that projects are effectively executed within budgeted cost and time schedules while ensuring positive cash flow. This is a customer\-facing role, and is responsible for maximizing customer satisfaction, safety, and quality assurance on all assigned projects. As a Project Manager, you are a part of a dynamic team that allows you to grow as Convergint grows.

  


**For information about how we use your personal information, please see our Colleague \& Applicant Privacy Notice, available on convergint.com/careers.**

  




**Who You Are**



You have a passion for providing world\-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results as an exceptional Project Manager.

  


**Who We Are**



With 20\-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the \#1 global, serviced\-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

  


**What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”**


* Convergint's greatest strength is our people! Every colleague is encouraged to participate in our Recruit Awesome People program, helping us grow Convergint by promoting our colleague\-first culture and referring top talent to the Talent Acquisition Team and hiring managers.
* Manage, oversee, and coordinate many aspects for small to medium projects of moderate complexity from award through completion of project.
* Translate a variety of customer needs / requirements into detailed proposals and project implementation plans to meet Customer requirements.
* Effectively communicate project requirements to project team and wider organization as and when required and maintains accurate and up to date records of job status, job changes, material flow and other control records necessary for processing of internal and external reports.
* Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint Technologies is the customer’s first choice for service.
* Coordinate the procurement of materials, supplies, services, and controls necessary for timely and cost\-effective completion of project within budget.
* Establish project milestones and analyze costs.
* May perform limited range of managerial responsibilities and oversee subcontractor selection process and work.

  


**What You’ll Need**


* Project management experience in a technical environment (building automation systems, fire alarm systems, and/or electronic security systems).
* Initiative – engages in proactive behavior and looks for opportunities and solutions.
* Strong analytical skills necessary to resolve problems and look for solutions, solid conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to facilitate a collaborative working environment for customers and team members.
* Extreme adaptability; respond effectively to changes in situation or information; ability to influence others and build consensus using advanced written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and staff development skills; solid leadership orientation. Actively seeks ways in which to act as a role model, guide, develop and mentor others within the organization.
* Strong financial analytical skills including cost control.
* Solid team leadership, team building and facilitation skills.
* Experience managing client relationships / communications.
* A valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

  


**Company Benefits**



Convergint fosters a supportive, accessible, and inclusive environment in which all individuals are able to realize their maximum potential within the company. We offer a variety of programs and exceptional benefits:


* 10 Company Holidays and Paid Time Off starting at 13 days annually
* Fun \& Laughter Day Off
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Plan
* Life insurance \& Disability Plan
* Wellness Program
* 401K Matching Plan
* Colleague Assistance Program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Competitive salary and compensation plan
* Vehicle reimbursement plan or company vehicle
* Corporate Social Responsibility Day
* Cell phone reimbursement (if applicable)
* Paid parental leave

  


**Requirements:**



Education: College degree, trade school or equivalent experience



Minimum Experience: 5\-7 years project management



Preferred Experience (but not required):


* 5 years relevant engineering, field service or project management
* Experience in 1 or more of the following industries: electronic, fire alarm \& life safety, and/or building automation
* Certifications \& Licenses: Project Management Institute (PMI); industry\-specific certifications and/or licenses

  



The expected compensation range for this position is between $105,000 \- $150,000 annually, depending on experience.



Please note that this job posting includes salary information for the assigned target market range within the primary geographic region the requisition is posted. If the position is posted in multiple locations or is a remote position, the salary range may vary. Individual pay rates will, of course, vary depending on the job, department, and location, as well as the individual skills, experience, certifications, specific licenses, and education of the applicant.

  



Convergint is an Equal Opportunity Employe

jobs.title: EHR Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) delivers personalized and actionable health insights to inform diagnosis, direct treatment, and improve drug discovery. The company is uniquely positioned to accelerate the use of genomic and large\-scale clinical information to enable precision medicine as the standard of care. GeneDx is at the forefront of transforming healthcare through its industry\-leading exome and genome testing and interpretation services, fueled by the world's largest, rare disease data sets. For more information, please visit www.genedx.com.


**Summary**



The EHR Implementation Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering large, cross\-functional programs that align with the company's strategic goals. This role ensures that multiple related projects stay on track, achieve broader business objectives, and drive organizational vision. The EHR Implementation Manager serves as a central point of alignment across internal and external stakeholders, managing resources, timelines, and risk to deliver program\-wide success.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Program Leadership: Oversee the entire program lifecycle, from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and company vision.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison across internal and external teams to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned and working toward common goals.
* Alignment and Planning: Develop program strategies in collaboration with senior leadership and define a roadmap for success with clear milestones.
* Risk and Issue Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate risks to ensure seamless progress, addressing roadblocks before they impact program outcomes.
* Resource Management: Coordinate resource allocation across projects to maximize efficiency and maintain balance across the program.
* Stakeholder Communication: Keep all relevant stakeholders informed of program progress, changes, and risks through regular updates and communication.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements across program operations, ensuring that best practices are followed and lessons learned are applied.


 **People Manager**


* No


**Education, Experience, and Skills**


* Bachelor's degree in business, Life Sciences, Engineering or a related field.
* Extensive experience (5\+ years) in program and project management, with a focus on cross\-functional collaboration.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated experience in implementing project management software.
* Familiarity with Epic, Aura, Cerner, eClinicalWorks, and other Electronic Health Record platforms.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication including an ability to communicate effectively at an executive level.
* Ability to work collaboratively across distributed workforce.
* Possesses significant practical experience in project management (project planning, resource planning, issue management, risk management, change management, communication planning).
* Excellent organizational skills and capable of setting priorities and a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time, on budget and within scope.
* Proven accomplishment as a driver of multiple projects running concurrently.
* Exhibit good judgment skills on when to seek guidance and when to escalate risks and issues.

  


**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**


* Epic certifications are desirable but not required


**Work Environment**



This is a fully remote position. The employee will work from a home office or other suitable remote location with reliable high\-speed internet access. Work is performed in a climate\-controlled environment using standard office equipment including computer, phone, and video conferencing tools. Your standard work schedule and hours will be established in collaboration with your leader and may be adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

  



\#LI\-REMOTE



### **A culture that plays to win, because patients are counting on us**

At GeneDx, we're driven by urgency and purpose: helping patients get diagnosed earlier. Our mission, to empower everyone to live their healthiest life through genomics, drives our team to make a tangible impact each day – and shapes our culture where high standards, strong teamwork, and meaningful ownership are the norm. We act with intention, support one another, and deliver work we're proud to put our names on.
  

  

**Here's what you can expect day to day:**  

  

1\. Play like a champion (step up, redefine what's possible, own it)


We bring energy, focus, and a bias for action. We step up, take initiative, and deliver on our commitments – with quality, speed, and care.  

  

  



2\. Think bigger (stretch beyond, courage not consensus)
We push past the obvious. We challenge assumptions, raise the bar, and make thoughtful, decisive calls — choosing progress over perfection.  

  

  



3\. Grow fast (be curious, speak up, be agile)
We stay curious, ask questions, and share direct feedback with respect. We adapt quickly and keep learning through collaboration and continuous improvement.
  

  

If you're motivated by meaningful work, a fast\-moving environment, and teammates who care deeply about outcomes, you'll thrive at GeneDx.



At GeneDx, we believe in taking care of our people. We provide competitive compensation and benefits that reflect local market practices and legal requirements in each country where we operate, helping employees thrive both professionally and personally.

We welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.


**GeneDx is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.**

  

All privacy policy information can be found here.

jobs.title: Workplace Project Manager, Project Management Office, Workplace Solutions Group
jobs.description:
**Please Note:**



To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6\-month period.


**Advancing the World's Technology Together**



Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day\-including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you'll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what's possible and powering the future.



We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We're dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we're building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

**What You'll Do**



Plan, support, and oversee a diverse portfolio of projects — including large\-scale capital projects, tenant improvement (TI), and technical infrastructure projects — ensuring timely delivery and budget compliance throughout the full project lifecycle from initiation through closeout. Provide comprehensive PMO administration, reporting, and strategic coordination while developing high\-quality documentation and executive\-level reports to support informed decision\-making across the organization.


**Location:** Daily onsite presence at our San Jose, CA in alignment with our Flexible Work policy

  

**Reports to:** PMO Lead, Project Management Office, Workplace Solutions Group


* Define project objectives, scope, and success criteria in alignment with organizational goals.
* Assess and predict resources needed to achieve objectives; manage resource allocation effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare budgets based on project requirements; track and control costs to ensure delivery within approved budget.
* Develop project charters, business cases, and detailed project plans including milestones, timelines, and risk registers.
* Track project progress and provide regular status reports to PMO and key stakeholders; manage and respond to changes in scope, schedule, and budget with appropriate corrective actions.
* Manage contracts and relationships with vendors and suppliers, ensuring compliance with agreed terms and quality standards.
* Apply industry best practices, methodologies, and standards throughout project execution.
* Prepare comprehensive closeout packages upon project completion, including lessons learned, best practices, and post\-project evaluations.
* Support planning and execution across a range of project types, including large\-scale capital projects, tenant improvement (TI), technical infrastructure upgrades, and other operational projects as assigned.
* Assist in the development of project briefs, scope definitions, and requirements documentation in coordination with internal stakeholders and external consultants.
* Coordinate with design teams, engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure projects align with organizational standards, timelines, and budget parameters.
* Conduct due diligence activities including site assessments, technical reviews, regulatory considerations, and risk analysis — adapted to the nature of each project type.
* Monitor and report on project milestones, construction or installation progress, and budget performance across the project portfolio.
* Support change management processes related to project delivery, including stakeholder communications, scope adjustments, and transition planning.
* Adapt project support approach flexibly based on project type, scale, and organizational priorities at any given time.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve PMO strategies, frameworks, and governance processes.
* Maintain and enhance standardized templates, tools, and documentation for consistent project management practice across the portfolio.
* Prepare executive\-level presentation materials, dashboards, and decision\-support documents for leadership meetings and steering committees.
* Produce and manage a variety of regular and ad hoc reports including project status reports, portfolio summaries, budget variance reports, and KPI tracking.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to promote efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness across project management practices.
* Regularly monitor portfolio\-wide project status; identify deviations from plan and recommend corrective actions to ensure on\-time, on\-budget delivery.
* Facilitate clear and effective communication among project team members, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment on project progress, decisions, and risks.
* Serve as a central point of coordination between internal teams and external partners on project\-related matters.
* Maintain strong working relationships with project vendors, contractors, and consultants to support quality outcomes and timely delivery.
* Coordinate cross\-functional meetings, prepare agendas, document meeting minutes, and follow up on action items to maintain project momentum.

  


**What You Bring**


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in construction, engineering or a relevant field of study.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience
* Proven working experience in project management
* Strong familiarity with project management software tools, methodologies, and best practices
* Experience managing projects through the full life cycle
* Excellent client\-facing and internal communication skills
* Proven ability to complete projects according to outlined scope, budget, and timeline

jobs.title: Document Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** 

The Document Quality Manager is responsible for overseeing the quality control and quality assurance of as\-built documentation and closeout deliverables for construction of utility infrastructure projects. This role ensures all documentation accurately reflects final project conditions, meets contractual requirements, and complies with company and client processes and standards. The manager leads a team of Document Quality specialists and coordinates closely with project management, clients, and field teams to ensure timely and accurate project closeout, including electronic filing and records management within company systems.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 

**As\-Built Documentation Review**

* Lead the comprehensive review of as\-built drawings, redlines, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with final installed conditions.
* Verify completeness and consistency across engineering drawings, specifications, and field documentation.
* Ensure updates from field changes, RFIs, change orders, and design revisions are properly incorporated into final as\-built records.
* Identify discrepancies or missing information and coordinate with engineering, field teams, or subcontractors to resolve issues.
* Promote and foster continuous process improvement to meet or exceed internal and external quality targets

**Closeout Documentation \& Data Analysis**

* Manage the collection, review, and validation of project data shared by the client.
* Analyze close\-out\-phase documentation to identify gaps, trends, and compliance issues prior to final project handover.
* Ensure all documentation meets contractual requirements, regulatory standards, and internal quality procedures.
* Prepare final closeout documentation packages for client submission.
* Act as liaison between client and field team. Able to communicate with field workers as well as upper\-level managers

**Governance, Quality Assurance \& Process Management**

* Develop and maintain documentation review procedures, checklists, and quality standards for as\-built and closeout documentation.
* Implement quality control workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Conduct internal quality audits of documentation prior to client delivery.
* Track documentation status, completeness metrics, and closeout readiness.
* Oversee electronic documentation management in compliance with retention policies.
* Facilitate and ensure alignment between internal vs external quality control standards in a dynamic working environment.

**Team Leadership**

* Oversee hiring, onboarding and retention of Document Quality Specialists; set team goals, development goals, performance management and conduct performance reviews.
* Supervise, mentor, and coordinate the work of a team of four document control specialists.
* Assign review tasks, monitor progress, and ensure deadlines for project closeout milestones are met.
* Provide training on documentation standards, systems, and quality procedures.
* Foster a collaborative and detail\-oriented team environment.
* Collaborate closely with internal field leadership to resolve documentation issues, report outcomes, identify solutions and drive increased collaboration across groups.

**Coordination \& Communication**

* Collaborate with project managers, project coordinators, construction teams, and subcontractors to obtain required documentation.
* Serve as functional owner for electronic document filing systems; folder structure configuration, workflows, and retention schedules to ensure documents remain organized, searchable and compliant throughout project life cycle.
* Provide status updates and reporting to project leadership regarding documentation readiness and risks.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent attention to detail and document quality standards.
* Strong leadership, coaching and workload prioritization abilities.
* Proficiency with document management systems and project documentation tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Effective communication and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills when resolving documentation discrepancies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in document control, project closeout, or quality assurance within construction, engineering, or infrastructure projects.
* Experience reviewing as\-built drawings and closeout documentation packages.
* Demonstrated experience supervising or leading a documentation team.
* Strong analytical skills for reviewing large documentation sets and identifying discrepancies.

Desired:

* Experience with construction closeout processes for large\-scale infrastructure or capital projects.
* Familiarity with utility industry documentation standards and regulatory requirements.

Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing / Precision Manufacturing  
**Department:** Quality  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and hands\-on **Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist** to join our semiconductor equipment manufacturing team.

The QA/QC Specialist will be responsible for inspecting incoming, in\-process, and finished components to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, customer specifications, and internal quality standards. This position will also support quality documentation, non\-conformance management, corrective actions, supplier quality, and continuous improvement activities.

The ideal candidate has experience in **precision machining, semiconductor equipment, or high\-precision manufacturing** and is comfortable working with engineering drawings, inspection equipment, and quality documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final inspections** of precision machined parts, fabricated components, assemblies, and purchased materials.
* Inspect parts according to **engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and customer requirements**.
* Use inspection and measurement equipment such as **calipers, micrometers, height gauges, pin gauges, thread gauges, surface roughness testers, optical measurement systems, and CMM equipment**, as applicable.
* Review and interpret **engineering drawings, GD\&T, dimensions, tolerances, surface finish requirements, and inspection criteria**.
* Verify material certifications, inspection reports, Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and other supplier quality documentation.
* Document inspection results accurately and maintain complete, traceable quality records.
* Identify, document, and control **non\-conforming materials and products**.
* Generate and manage **Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs)** and coordinate disposition with Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and other departments.
* Assist with **root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA)** for internal, supplier, and customer quality issues.
* Support supplier quality activities, including communicating quality issues, reviewing corrective actions, and monitoring supplier performance.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve dimensional, workmanship, documentation, and manufacturing quality issues.
* Support customer quality requirements and assist with customer complaints, returns, and corrective action requests when necessary.
* Ensure inspection tools and measurement equipment are properly maintained and within calibration.
* Assist with maintaining and improving quality procedures, inspection instructions, forms, and work instructions.
* Support internal and external quality audits as required.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts to reduce defects, rework, scrap, and recurring quality issues.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and controlled inspection/work area.
* Perform other quality\-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical field is preferred.
* **2\+ years of QA/QC or inspection experience** in semiconductor equipment, precision machining, aerospace, medical device, or another high\-precision manufacturing environment preferred.
* Experience inspecting **CNC machined components and precision mechanical parts** is highly preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret **mechanical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T**.
* Hands\-on experience using precision measurement and inspection tools.
* Understanding of **quality inspection processes, NCRs, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and document control**.
* Familiarity with **ISO 9001 or similar Quality Management Systems (QMS)** is preferred.
* Experience with CMM inspection is a plus.
* Knowledge of semiconductor equipment manufacturing requirements, cleanliness standards, surface finish requirements, and precision components is a plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and general computer systems.
* Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate quality concerns professionally with suppliers, customers, engineers, and production personnel.
* Ability to prioritize multiple inspections and quality issues in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Management.

Preferred Skills

* Semiconductor equipment or semiconductor industry experience
* CNC machining / precision machining knowledge
* GD\&T
* CMM inspection
* First Article Inspection (FAI)
* Incoming Quality Control (IQC)
* In\-Process Quality Control (IPQC)
* Final Quality Control (FQC)
* Supplier Quality
* NCR / MRB management
* Root Cause Analysis
* CAPA / Corrective Action
* 5 Why / Fishbone analysis
* ISO 9001
* Calibration management
* Inspection report preparation
* Blueprint / engineering drawing interpretation

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and work in an inspection/manufacturing environment for extended periods.
* Ability to safely handle and inspect mechanical components of various sizes.
* Ability to lift up to **30 lbs.** as needed.
* Ability to visually inspect precision components and use measurement equipment accurately.

What We Offer

Position Summary:

The Knowledge Base Program Manager is responsible for leading the management, optimization, and governance of Technology Credit Union’s (Tech CU) enterprise knowledge ecosystem, including Tech CU’s Knowledge Hub. This role partners closely with business units, subject‑matter experts, leadership, and cross\-functional partners to design and employ scalable content governance practices, manage content workflows, strengthen taxonomy and search effectiveness, maintain a unified organizational voice, and leverage knowledge base analytics and AI capabilities to continuously optimize Tech CU’s knowledge management program. The incumbent is equal parts content strategist, systems administrator, process designer, and program manager.


Responsibilities:
**Essential Duties**

  



Knowledge Hub Program Management

* Serves as the program manager for Tech CU’s Knowledge Hub, including configuration, content lifecycle management, and user permissions.
* Designs and maintains the structure, taxonomy, metadata, and search optimization within the platform.
* Monitors system performance, usage patterns, and analytics to ensure the knowledge base remains accurate, accessible, and effective.
* Establishes annual priorities, maturity goals, and adoption plans.
* Aligns knowledge initiatives with operational, service, compliance, and training goals.
* Promotes a knowledge\-sharing culture across the organization.


Content Governance \& Workflow Design* Partners with business areas to design, implement, and maintain content review and approval workflows that ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely updates.
* Establishes and enforces content governance standards, including version control, archival rules, and quality benchmarks.
* Coordinates with SMEs to ensure content is regularly reviewed, validated, and aligned with business needs.


Content Quality \& Unified Voice* Ensures all knowledge articles follow a consistent tone, structure, and voice across the organization.
* In collaboration with Marketing, develops and maintains style guides, templates, and best practices for content creation.
* Provides coaching and editorial support to content contributors to maintain clarity, accuracy, and usability.


Knowledge Gap Identification \& Optimization* Uses analytics, AI insights, and reporting tools to identify knowledge gaps, outdated content, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborates with business partners to prioritize and close gaps through new or updated content.
* Tracks the impact of knowledge improvements on customer experience, operational efficiency, and agent performance.


Cross‑Functional Collaboration* Chairs or facilitates a cross\-functional governance forum.
* Advises business leaders and process owners on knowledge management best practices.
* Works closely with customer service, operations, product, compliance, risk, technology, and training teams to ensure the knowledge base supports organizational goals.
* Facilitates workshops, training sessions, and onboarding for new contributors and reviewers.
* Acts as the internal advocate for knowledge management best practices.

**Work Schedule**

* Full\-time; typically 40\+ hours/week.
* Flexible within core business hours, Pacific Time, M\-F.
* Occasional extended early morning or late evening hours, and weekends, typically with advance notice.

**Workplace Essentials**

* Complies with Tech CU policies and procedures.
* Upholds employee Code of Conduct and Business Ethics and ensures confidentiality of the workplace.
* Complies with requirements imposed by federal, state, and local regulatory agencies.
* Adheres to internal control and security measures designed to ensure regulatory compliance and mitigate losses and errors.


Qualifications:
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or related area (or equivalent experience).

 **Experience:*** 5\+ years of experience in knowledge management, process management, content management, technical writing, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience leading an enterprise knowledge, process governance, or cross\-functional improvement initiatives.
* 3\+ years of experience managing an enterprise knowledge platform and developing or managing content review and approval workflows across multiple business units. Experience with eGain Knowledge Hub is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using analytics or reporting tools to identify knowledge gaps, optimize content, and improve user experience. Experience influencing stakeholders and establishing standards across multiple departments.
* Experience supporting customer\-facing or contact\-center environments is strongly preferred.
* Prior experience in regulated environments, financial services, or credit unions is preferred.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Demonstrated ability to lead enterprise programs, design governance frameworks, and influence stakeholders across business areas without direct authority.
* Proficiency in process mapping, change management, and continuous improvement, with demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical knowledge and process standards.
* Advanced knowledge of knowledge management principles and practices, including taxonomy, metadata, information architecture, and content lifecycle management.

* Demonstrated ability to define KPIs, interpret performance reporting, and translate findings into measurable improvements.

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


### **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



Our Customer Success team powers long\-term customer value and growth across the West region. We're hiring Customer Success Managers based in San Francisco or Redwood City to own a book of SMB accounts, drive adoption, and partner with customers to deliver measurable outcomes. You'll bring operational rigor, a growth mindset, and strong relationship skills to help our customers realize the full value of Box.



In this role, you will manage a curated portfolio with flexibility to travel for high\-impact onsite moments. You'll collaborate across teams, lead value\-focused demos, and turn insights into action that increases retention and expansion.


### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**



We are an AI\-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.


* Own a book of West region SMB accounts and build trusted partnerships that drive adoption, renewal, and growth.
* Lead discovery, value reviews, and product demos that tie business goals to clear outcomes.
* Maintain operational rigor across systems—forecast renewals, track health, and prioritize actions based on signals.
* Build account plans, identify risks/opportunities, and execute proactive playbooks to improve customer value.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to remove roadblocks and deliver solutions that matter.
* Prioritize customer meetings (virtual and onsite as needed) to accelerate impact across your territory.
* Surface insights from your portfolio to influence territory planning and process improvements.
* Champion a growth mindset and experiment with AI\-enabled workflows to scale customer success.

### **WHO YOU ARE**


* 2\+ years of customer success, account management, or related client\-facing experience managing a book of business.
* Proven track record of ownership and proactive problem\-solving that led to measurable customer outcomes.
* Strong relationship management and communication skills; comfortable leading demos and executive conversations.
* Operationally rigorous with experience navigating business systems for forecasting and health tracking.
* Growth\-minded, coachable, and adaptable; excited to learn and leverage AI to improve workflows.
* Comfortable managing a mixed SMB portfolio, prioritizing impact across multiple accounts.
* Hybrid: Based in San Francisco or Redwood City with 3 days/week in\-office; travel within the West region as needed.

Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in.If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. Box strives to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and is committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees. Inclusiveness is core to our culture at Box, and we strive to ensure you get the most from your interview experience.



Box makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please complete this form. Reasonable accommodations may include scheduling adjustments, document dictation and beyond.

**Who We Are**



Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap\-around services. All our services are trauma\-sensitive and client\-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.

**Preferred:**

RRC operates a single integrated continuum of care on one property: clients live on\-site in a supervised, home\-like sober living residence while attending structured clinical programming — Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP, ASAM Level 2\.5\) and Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP, ASAM Level 2\.1\) — delivered through individual, group, and family sessions. RRC believes recovery is possible for every person, and our team works together across housing, clinical, and medical services so that treatment feels like one connected experience rather than separate programs under one roof.



RP is hiring a full\-time Case Manager within RRC to serve as the connective thread between our sober living residence and our PHP/IOP clinical programs. This is a non\-clinical, client\-facing coordination role: you will not provide therapy or counseling, but you will be the person who makes sure every client's practical, logistical, and support needs are identified, tracked, and followed through on — from a scheduled appointment or a referral to community services, to helping a client in their final weeks of sober living line up a job and permanent housing. jobs.title: Office Manager / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Us**

  

Medical data exchange is one of the biggest unsolved problems in US healthcare. If you've spent any real time in the healthcare system, you've felt it, and it only gets worse the sicker and older you get. Metriport exists to fix that. We connect to the data sources the healthcare providers of tomorrow need, take raw data that's unusable in its source form, and turn it into a single clean format that care teams, and their agents, actually use to improve outcomes. Record retrieval across thousands of legacy systems and antiquated data pipes that used to take weeks now takes seconds. Clinicians walk into appointments with the full patient picture already in hand, and that speed can mean spotting a condition early enough to actually treat it.


We're not a healthcare company. We're a technology company that happens to operate in healthcare, and we build every layer ourselves: connect, transform, and insight. Legacy EHRs were built to get providers paid, not to serve the clinical experience. We're building what should have existed instead: the system of record for all of US healthcare. We started in data exchange. Today we compete with the largest data platforms in the space. Tomorrow we will be the infrastructure layer healthcare runs on.


We’ve raised $28\.4 million from top\-tier VCs (including Matrix, ARTIS and Y Combinator), found product\-market fit (multi\-million dollar ARR, 100\+ customers including Amazon One Medical, Circle Medical, Color Health, and Strive Health), and have years of runway ahead of us. If you’ve had a good healthcare experience in the past few years, there’s a good chance Metriport was behind it. That’s the version of healthcare we want people to not just expect, but demand. Join us and build the future.  

  

**About You**

We're a small, high\-output team, mostly former founders including YC alumni, and we operate with real autonomy and almost no bureaucracy. We hire on competence, not pedigree. Leaders are in the office six days a week, and we generally expect the team to be available six days a week too. Not because we count hours, but because there's always more wood to chop when revolutionizing how tomorrow’s healthcare providers deliver care to their patients today. We trust our team to take the time off they need and we've never said no to a time off request.  

  

You have an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership. You don't wait to be told what's broken. Instead, you believe you can figure out any problem that lands in your lap even outside your exact domain. When someone scopes something for three weeks, you ask why it can't be done in three days, and you also know the difference between shipping a fast v0 and cutting a corner that comes back to bite you. You walk the tightrope between craft and speed without falling off either side.

**The Role**


We’re looking for an Office Manager / Executive Assistant to keep our SF office running and support our leadership team. This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role with direct impact on how we operate day\-to\-day. You’ll be in our SF office Monday through Friday.


You’ll split your time roughly equally between office operations and executive support with cross\-functional opportunities. If you’re energized by building systems from scratch, thrive when no two days look the same, and want a path into People / HR as the company scales—this role was built for you.


**What You’ll Do**

**Office Management**

* Own the SF office experience end\-to\-end: supplies, snacks, equipment, vendors, and facilities
* Lead office build\-out initiatives as we grow: coordinate with contractors, landlord, and vendors
* Plan and execute internal events (team offsites, all\-hands, celebrations, customer visits)
* Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for office services
* Maintain operational docs and processes in Notion; coordinate team communication in Slack and Linear
* Support onboarding logistics for new hires and assist with People / HR projects over time

**Recruiting coordination and sourcing**

* Work with our internal recruiter on sourcing and screening candidates
* Build and maintain sourcing funnels, craft personalized messages, and track response rates
* Schedule and coordinate initial calls with candidates and follow\-up meetings between candidates and hiring managers

**Executive Support**

* Manage complex calendars for both leaders: scheduling internal meetings, external calls, and personal appointments across time zones
* Coordinate domestic travel: flights, hotels, ground transport, and itineraries
* Track follow\-ups, action items, and commitments so nothing falls through the cracks
* Draft and send communications on behalf of leadership as needed
* Assist with ad hoc research, vendor outreach, and special projects

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–2\+ years as an Office Manager, Executive Assistant, or similar role at an early\-stage startup
* **Presence:** Based in San Francisco; available in\-office 5 days per week (Monday\-Friday mornings)
* **Startup DNA:** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, can prioritize across competing demands without hand\-holding, and enjoy building things from scratch
* **Organized by default:** You maintain clean systems for calendars, tasks, and follow\-ups without being reminded
* **Strong communicator:** Clear and professional in writing and in\-person; comfortable interfacing directly with founders and external partners
* **Proactive:** You identify problems before they surface and propose solutions, not just questions
* **Tool\-savvy:** Proficient with Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace; bonus if you’ve used Linear

**Preferred:** Interest in growing into a People/HR Operations role as Metriport scales

jobs.title: 2027 Business Operations Summer Internship
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Not sure you want to work directly in insurance sales or client service? Interested in HR, Marketing, Finance, IT, or business operations?  

Heffernan’s Corporate Operations Internship gives college students the opportunity to experience the business side of a growing insurance organization while working alongside professionals across specific corporate functions.
  

This 10\-week program is designed for students who are interested in how organizations operate behind the scenes. You’ll gain exposure to real business projects, learn how corporate teams support an insurance brokerage, and develop practical skills that can translate into a variety of career paths.  

  

**Potential Corporate Pathways**  

**Information Technology*** Technology and systems
* Help desk and user support
* Data and reporting
* Business applications
* Technology projects and process improvement

**Marketing*** Marketing and communications
* Social media and digital content
* Brand and creative projects
* Events and campaigns
* Business development support

**Finance*** Financial reporting and analysis
* Data analysis
* Accounting and financial operations
* Budgeting and business reporting
* Process improvement

**Operations*** Business processes and workflows
* Project management
* Data and reporting
* Process improvement
* Cross\-functional business initiatives

**Human Resources*** Talent acquisition and recruiting
* Employee engagement and culture
* HR operations
* Learning and development
* People, programs, and projects

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Work alongside experienced professionals in one or more corporate departments.
* Contribute to real business projects and initiatives.
* Learn how corporate functions support the day\-to\-day operations of an insurance brokerage.
* Gain exposure to cross\-functional projects and collaboration.
* Assist with research, data analysis, reporting, and presentations.
* Learn how business processes are developed, managed, and improved.
* Participate in department meetings and team activities.
* Build an understanding of how HR, IT, Marketing, Finance, and Operations work together.
* Participate in professional development, mentoring, and networking opportunities.
* Complete an intern group project and present your work to Heffernan leadership.

  

### **What We Are Looking For**

  

* Students entering their sophomore, junior, or senior year of college. Graduating seniors will also be considered.
* Interested in business, corporate operations, HR, IT, marketing, finance, project management, or a related field.
* Curious and eager to learn about different areas of a business.
* Strong communicators with excellent organizational skills.
* Comfortable working with data, technology, or business processes.
* Analytical and/or creative thinkers.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Collaborative and comfortable working with different teams.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative.
* A minimum 3\.0 GPA is preferred.
* Ability to receive coaching and feedback and apply it to improve performance.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
* Professional demeanor and behavior are required, as referenced in Heffernan’s core values (Habits).

  

### **Why Heffernan?**

  

At Heffernan, our mission is simple: Answer the Phone and Have Fun! We pride ourselves on creating an environment where people enjoy their work while delivering for our clients. As an intern, you'll work side\-by\-side with experienced professionals, build relationships across the organization, participate in networking and social events, and gain real\-world experience that can help launch your career.
  

Regardless of your internship path, you’ll be part of a summer cohort and have opportunities to:* Participate in insurance and professional development training.
* Meet with and learn from Heffernan leaders.
* Work on a team\-based intern project.
* Attend networking, social, and community events.
* Participate in workshops focused on resumes, interviewing, personal branding, and career development.
* Receive one\-on\-one coaching and mentoring.
* Present your final project to Heffernan leadership.
* Build relationships with other interns and employees across the organization.

  

**Heffernan Habits (Expectations):**
These are practices that represent our unique culture.* **Answer The Phone (And Email)**: Communication is the foundation of success in life, work, and relationships. It begins with being present and responsive to both clients and colleagues. Listen to what is said and notice what goes unsaid.
* **Have Fun**: Fun is something we don’t shy away from, and participation brings us together on many different levels. Take the time to know your colleagues and let barriers fall away. If we are happy and enjoy time together, we will do a better job for our clients and for one another!
* **Be Respectful:** Lend a hand, be kind, and smooth the path. Respect is the cornerstone of developing and maintaining strong relationships. Lead with humility, take ownership of your actions, and ease the way for others. We are in this together as a team, as a family, and as trusted advisors to many.
* **Do Good**: This is our core. We strive to do good for our clients, our community, and our planet.
* **Celebrate \& Value Our Differences**: “Because You’re Different”. It is our differences, when valued and amplified, that allow us to innovate, to learn, to connect, and to stand apart from the rest.

  

### **About Heffernan Insurance Brokers**

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year
  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
* Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross\-functional programs or projects.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with R, SQL, spreadsheets, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure or SaaS commercial programs and business models.
* Exposure to statistical analysis, driver analysis, and incrementality calculations.
* Ability to form excellent working relationships across business, operational, and technical functions.
* Comfort with sprints to rapidly answer executive asks.

**About the job**
-----------------


Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  

  

Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross\-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.



As a Lead for market insights, you are responsible for building a robust and scalable platform where we monitor and collect critical signals of market intelligence and participant behavior. You will use this process to track and identify trends that help us understand what customers want and what our participants are doing in the market, allowing us to stay one step ahead. You will assist with the steady stream of inbound executive requests for information and insights, while allowing us to proactively identify patterns and bring these to leaders across the Cloud business.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $176000 \- $256000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Identify and solve organizational problems by defining, leading, and establishing effective operating programs, processes, and tools to achieve key business goals.
* Influence cross\-functional teams and executive management to drive complex, strategic programs and market intelligence initiatives to successful completion.
* Develop AI\-driven agents and processes to monitor, collect, and analyze participant and market intelligence data in near\-real time at scale.
* Build and scale a robust data repository to proactively track market shifts, participant focus areas, and rapidly answer high\-priority executive inquiries.
* Create and deliver high\-impact presentations and visual displays of quantitative insights to communicate market trends and strategic recommendations to stakeholders.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **Position: Account Manager**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA**


Amphenol High Speed and Commercial Products Groups are the market leaders for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom and Diverse market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales, and manufacturing locations globally. We are currently seeking an Account Manager to join our West Coast Sales team in Santa Clara, CA.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


The Account Manager is the voice of the customer into the organization as well as the voice of Amphenol out to the customer. This highly visible role will have responsibility for one of the largest OEM customers within the High Speed Products Group. The position requires excellent communication skills but also has a substantial focus on financial and market data.

* Preparing monthly and quarterly revenue projections for the account(s)
* Forecast analysis and preparing book\-to\-ship estimates
* Preparing negotiation strategy in conjunction with sales and product line management, submitting proposals and negotiating order fulfillment agreements to maximize share
* Coordinating customer activities, including product ramp strategies and resolution of delivery, quality, inventory, and financial issues in an international environment
* Prepare market share goals and work with sales, product management and operations to achieve those objectives and resolve any shortfalls to the plan
* Identify end customer market analysis/opportunities and develop plans to fulfill gaps to close the total available market space


A successful candidate will be skilled at working with a high level of detail and will be able to manage multiple tasks for customers in a time sensitive environment. They will also make presentations to top management; organizational skills and summarizing conclusions via data analysis is an important part of the position. To do so requires a strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to communicate effectively. Some travel may be required.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* BS Degree in Marketing, Business or related area, MBA preferred
* Bi\-lingual Spanish/English Required
* Advanced PC Skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint, working ability with V\-lookups, Pivot Tables, and other more advanced excel skills
* 3\+ year of experience in Marketing, Customer Service, Planning or Finance
* Ability to effectively communicate across multiple functions internally and externally
* Strong oral and written communications to provide high level customer service and build relationships
* Detail\-oriented with keen business acumen


The base salary range for this position is $68,320 \- $104,400 annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.

  

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.


Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

Amphenol High Speed and Commercial Products Groups are the market leaders for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom and Diverse market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales, and manufacturing locations globally. We are currently seeking an Account Manager to join our West Coast Sales team in Santa Clara, CA.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


The Account Manager is the voice of the customer into the organization as well as the voice of Amphenol out to the customer. This highly visible role will have responsibility for one of the largest OEM customers within the High Speed Products Group. The position requires excellent communication skills but also has a substantial focus on financial and market data.


* Preparing monthly and quarterly revenue projections for the account(s)
* Forecast analysis and preparing book\-to\-ship estimates
* Preparing negotiation strategy in conjunction with sales and product line management, submitting proposals and negotiating order fulfillment agreements to maximize share
* Coordinating customer activities, including product ramp strategies and resolution of delivery, quality, inventory, and financial issues in an international environment
* Prepare market share goals and work with sales, product management and operations to achieve those objectives and resolve any shortfalls to the plan
* Identify end customer market analysis/opportunities and develop plans to fulfill gaps to close the total available market space

A successful candidate will be skilled at working with a high level of detail and will be able to manage multiple tasks for customers in a time sensitive environment. They will also make presentations to top management; organizational skills and summarizing conclusions via data analysis is an important part of the position. To do so requires a strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to communicate effectively. Some travel may be required.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* BS Degree in Marketing, Business or related area, MBA preferred
* Bi\-lingual Spanish/English Required
* Advanced PC Skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint, working ability with V\-lookups, Pivot Tables, and other more advanced excel skills
* 3\+ year of experience in Marketing, Customer Service, Planning or Finance
* Ability to effectively communicate across multiple functions internally and externally
* Strong oral and written communications to provide high level customer service and build relationships
* Detail\-oriented with keen business acumen

The base salary range for this position is $68,320 \- $104,400 annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.


Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.


Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - AI, Robotics, & Emerging Technologies
jobs.description:
**Who You Are**



Join FANUC America at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Industrial Robotics. Based in Northern California (primarily the Bay Area), this strategic sales role will lead FANUC's engagement with the rapidly growing ecosystem of robotics startups, AI innovators, and venture\-backed technology companies developing the next generation of intelligent automation solutions. This is a unique opportunity to influence how Physical AI, ROS2, autonomous robotics, digital twins, and advanced software platforms are deployed across FANUC's global installed base of industrial and collaborative robots.


**How It's Done**


* Develop and execute strategic growth initiatives targeting robotics startups, AI companies, venture\-backed technology firms, research institutions, and innovation ecosystems throughout Northern California and North America, positioning FANUC as the preferred robotics platform for advanced applications in artificial intelligence, machine learning, autonomous systems, physical AI, simulation, and robotic software
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with founders, CTOs, robotics architects, AI researchers, engineering executives, venture investors, universities, robotics laboratories, startup accelerators, incubators, and innovation centers to influence automation technology adoption and identify emerging business opportunities
* Identify opportunities to expand adoption of FANUC robot and controller technologies by supporting software\-first and AI\-driven application development, including integration with ROS2 frameworks, AI inference engines, cloud platforms, edge computing architectures, and advanced robotic software environments
* Collaborate closely with FANUC engineering, product management, and technical teams to communicate emerging market trends, customer requirements, software integration needs, and next\-generation technology opportunities that influence future product development and market strategy
* Represent FANUC at robotics, AI, automation, and startup ecosystem events, including technical conferences, industry forums, venture capital events, developer communities, and innovation programs, serving as a thought leader and ambassador for FANUC technologies
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of target industries, accounts, and senior leadership by:
	+ Researching market trends, regulatory and economic factors, and value/supply chains
	+ Analyzing customer business models, operations, financial performance, strategic objectives, and competitive landscape, including FAC, FANUC, and partner presence
	+ Evaluating executive roles, priorities, and backgrounds to enable informed, credible, and highly personalized engagement at the C\-suite level
* Determine best engagement strategies for current and prospective clients
* Develop strategies and action plans to improve overall customer satisfaction
* Develop, implement, and actively maintain comprehensive key account strategic plans
* Drive sales strategy
* Assess competitive threats and market dynamics and develop strategies to strengthen FAC's position within assigned accounts
* Insight development identifying both short\-term opportunities and long\-term strategic initiatives
* Executive\-level relationship development
* Coordinate facility automation audits with the appropriate FAC execution teams and/or ASI partners to identify operational challenges and potential automation opportunities
* Identify and facilitate engagement with appropriate ASI partners and monitor the progress of ASI and end\-user relationships throughout the sales cycle
* Conduct quarterly or semiannual business reviews with key customer stakeholders to review open issues, ongoing projects, support requirements, emerging opportunities, and account performance
* Regularly visit customer sites within assigned accounts and territory to strengthen relationships, support strategic initiatives, and identify new business opportunities


**What You Need**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration or related field; or equivalent relevant experience
* Minimum five years of capital equipment sales with proven selling and negotiation skills, experience developing strategic account plans
* Experience in the robotics and/or automation industry
* Minimum three years of selling experience at the c\-suite level of an organization with established contacts within select markets and industry verticals
* A strong understanding of end\-to\-end Physical AI system that combines perception, reasoning, and autonomous action
* Must currently reside and/or have established business relationships in Northern California
* Must have or be able to obtain a valid driver's license


**What Would Be Even Better**


* Master's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
* Extensive knowledge of manufacturing processes
* 5\+ years of experience in the robotics and/or automation industry with working knowledge of FANUC products
* Experience working with robotics startups, AI companies, autonomous systems developers, or industrial software providers
* Understanding of robotics software architectures, ROS2, industrial communication protocols, edge computing, and AI\-enabled automation technologies
* Experience with Isaac Sim, generative AI, reinforcement learning, and industrial robotics
* Familiarity with software\-centric business models including SaaS, robotics\-as\-a\-service (RaaS), platform ecosystems, and developer enablement programs
* Experience developing strategic partnerships within startup, venture capital, university, or technology innovation ecosystems
* Knowledge of machine learning, computer vision, foundation models, large language models, physical AI, or autonomous robotics technologies applied to industrial environments


**It's Your Move**



Joining FANUC means becoming part of a team that values your unique perspective and encourages continuous learning and collaboration

* 4 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, or analytics in a technology company.
* Experience with data analysis and creating presentations or briefings.

Product Strategy and Operations members work with teams across Google to bring together a cohesive set of data, insights, and deliverables for senior leaders.
