Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $126000 \- $180000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

jobs.title: HR Generalist (Bilingual in Mandarin)
jobs.description:
**About Sporton**  
Since its inception in 1986, Sporton International has been focusing on providing customers with professional product testing and certification services. With years of dedication, Sporton International has become a designated testing lab for regulatory bodies such as BSMI, NCC, and TAF and acquired professional certificates including PTCRB, GCF and CTIA. With solid credibility in the industry, Sporton International now is the largest test lab specializing in EMC/Safety tests.

**Job Overview**

The HR Generalist will manage daily HR operations, ensure compliance with California Labor Law, and handle tasks such as hiring, onboarding, training, benefits enrollment, and Workers' Comp. The role requires strong HR knowledge and interpersonal skills to support a high\-performance culture and workforce development. We will offer a salary package commensurate with experience.

**Responsibilities**

1\. **Employee Relations**

* Address employee queries and resolve issues promptly.

2\. **Recruitment and Onboarding**

* Manage recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training.
* Handle job postings, candidate shortlisting, and interview scheduling.

3\. **HR Policies and Compliance**

* Update and enforce HR policies and company guidelines to ensure compliance with regulations.
* Maintain and revise the Employee Handbook and mandatory programs.

5\. **Benefits Administration**

* Coordinate benefits open enrollment and address employee benefit inquiries.
* Manage benefits\-related documentation and employee requests.

6\. **Records and Documentation**

* Maintain and organize employee records, benefits, and attendance.
* Ensure accurate documentation for employment verifications and internal tracking.

7\. **Government and Insurance**

* Respond to government agency inquiries and handle Workers' Comp claims.
* Manage compliance with federal and state employment regulations.

8\. **Training and Development**

* Support departmental and organizational training initiatives.

Note: Additional tasks may be assigned as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field
* Proficient understanding of HR laws, regulations, and best practices
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills
* Analytical mindset with a focus on accuracy
* Fluent in English \& Mandarin (Required)

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: ServiceNow Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**ServiceNow Senior Project Manager**
=====================================


**Company:** CoreX  

**Position:** Senior Project Manager – ServiceNow  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**Role Overview**
-----------------


CoreX is seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Senior Project Manager** to lead complex ServiceNow implementations and transformation initiatives from initiation through successful delivery.


This individual will be responsible for managing the full project lifecycle, coordinating cross\-functional delivery teams, maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.


The ideal candidate has significant experience managing **ServiceNow implementations within a consulting or professional services environment** and is comfortable leading multiple workstreams, managing executive\-level stakeholders, and driving accountability across technical and functional teams.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex ServiceNow implementation and transformation projects.
* Own project scope, timelines, budgets, resource plans, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery performance.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between CoreX delivery teams and customer stakeholders.
* Lead project kickoff meetings, status meetings, steering committee meetings, and executive\-level communications.
* Coordinate ServiceNow Architects, Business Process Consultants, Developers, Technical Consultants, and other project resources.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, RAID logs, status reports, and financial forecasts.
* Proactively identify project risks, blockers, scope changes, and resource constraints and drive them toward resolution.
* Manage project financials, including budget tracking, resource utilization, forecasting, and overall project health.
* Partner with technical and functional teams to ensure customer requirements and business objectives are translated into successful ServiceNow solutions.
* Manage customer expectations and maintain strong relationships throughout the engagement.
* Ensure appropriate governance, documentation, quality controls, and delivery methodologies are followed.
* Support change management and escalation processes when necessary.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes and overall customer satisfaction.
* Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously when required.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 8\+ years of Project Management experience, preferably within technology consulting or SaaS implementations.
* 4\+ years of experience managing **ServiceNow implementations or ServiceNow\-related projects**.
* Previous experience working for a **ServiceNow Partner or within a professional services/consulting organization is highly preferred**.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow implementation lifecycle and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience managing enterprise\-scale implementations involving multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Strong experience managing project budgets, timelines, resources, scope, risks, and change requests.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with executive stakeholders, technical teams, and business leaders.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Experience working with distributed and cross\-functional delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* PMP, PMI\-ACP, Scrum Master, or similar Project Management certification.
* ServiceNow certifications or formal ServiceNow training.
* Experience delivering projects across ServiceNow workflows such as ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HRSD, S2P, SPM, or other enterprise workflows.
* Experience managing large enterprise or multi\-workstream ServiceNow programs.
* Experience working directly with ServiceNow Professional Services or within the ServiceNow Partner ecosystem.

jobs.title: Market Manager, Mining
jobs.description:
**Be an Owner, not a number!** As a 100% employee\-owned firm, our culture thrives on collaboration, sharing of ideas, and open communication, which encourages contributions from every one of our employee owners. As a multi\-disciplined, full\-service firm, success is achieved by our entire team working towards a common goal to provide innovative design solutions, which means you will be challenged, you will be encouraged to bring your ideas, and your contributions will make an impact!



Are you an engineering professional who has extensive knowledge of mining operations and infrastructure requirements? Do you have a thorough understanding of trends, current practices, and future forecasts associated with the mining industry? Do you have a successful track record of cultivating, nurturing, and fostering relationships and a desire to lead efforts to expand and enhance the engineering services we offer to current and prospective mining clients? If so, we have an exciting, challenging, and rewarding opportunity for you to join our Mining Engineering team as the Mining Market Manager for the Southwest Region!



As the Mining Market Manager, you will advance our engineering services within the mining market sector around Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, and Utah. You will develop and implement business plans that focus on enhancing capabilities and increasing awareness of our service offerings to secure surface mining projects and contract opportunities that align with annual and 5\-year strategic revenue and profit goals.



As a member our team, you will collaborate with a multi\-disciplined group of architectural and engineering professionals (civil, mechanical, electrical, structural) to cross\-sell services throughout the firm, identify prospective and strategic clients and project opportunities, track and respond to Request for Proposals (RFPs), and prepare for interviews and presentations. You will also collaborate with Project Managers to define project scope and scheduling requirements, negotiate contracts, determine staffing assignments for project teams, establish design standards, review design plans for technical quality and accuracy, and monitor expenditures and budget parameters. You will play a vital role in cultivating and maintaining relations with technical and industry leaders by leading outreach programs, attending networking events, and actively participating in committees and associations. On occasion, you may also assume the role of Project Manager or Project Engineer depending on the size of the project or the technical / design requirements.



### **Location and Work Arrangement**


Geography isn’t a limiting factor for this position, which is why we are open to remote candidates whose experience and qualifications align with this position and market development initiatives. Preference may be given to candidates who reside within the Southwest (Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, or Utah) due to proximity to existing and target client operations. Regular travel to TKDA offices, project locations, and team events will be expected to foster collaboration, strengthen relationships, and support project success.

### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Mining or Structural Engineering.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience designing, commissioning, or managing a portfolio of mining, facility, and infrastructure projects; crushing, conveying, slurry and water pumping and pipelines, ore concentrating plants, plant and enabling infrastructure.
* Minimum of five years of multi\-disciplined project management experience with a reputation for providing superior customer service and a successful track record of effectively managing client expectations, project scope, fee estimates, budgets, and schedules.
* Minimum of two years of business development experience demonstrated by a track record of cultivating, nurturing, and deepening client relations and an ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities to increase revenue and improve market share.
* Thorough understanding of the mining industry operations with emphasis on processing, and infrastructure; ability to identify trends, suggest solutions, and guide clients’ ideas into functional and buildable solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to apply effective written and verbal communication and presentation skills when developing proposals, preparing technical reports and documentation, conducting project interviews, leading team meetings, and engaging in discussions related to market and divisional operations.
* Working knowledge of design applications including Revit and/or AutoCAD.
* Flexibility to travel up to 20% overnight to conduct on\-site consultations, lead or participate in project meetings, and attend business development and industry events.
* Prior experience engaging in business development activities \- including proposal preparations, development of scope and fee estimates, and facilitation / leading of capabilities or qualifications presentations.
* Demonstrated track record of securing project opportunities with established, emerging, and prospective clients.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop a team of mechanical engineering professionals consisting of registered engineers, designers, and technicians with varying competencies, knowledge, qualifications, and experience.
* Superior focus on quality demonstrated by an ability adhere to design requirements, utilize and/or implement thorough quality review measures, and continuously evaluate practices to ensure technical accuracy and enhance project delivery methods.
* Demonstrated commitment to promoting and advancing a culture of safety excellence that emphasizes employee training, project / site risk assessment and mitigation, and strict adherence to all internal and external safety policies, requirements, and regulations.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Appraisal Operations
jobs.description:
The Business Analyst is responsible for providing strong analytical, process optimization, and project management support to Clear Capital’s CX Operations Group. Bring a pioneer spirit, a desire to be part of something that changes the valuation industry, and a drive to turn complex operational challenges into scalable solutions.
  

An intermediate individual contributor role, the Analyst provides in\-depth analytical and strategic program support to several key initiatives simultaneously. This role goes beyond tactical support to drive strategic process improvement and bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. Primary objectives include empowering the CX Organization with actionable insights through data analytics, ensuring project alignment with broader operational goals, and delivering transparent reporting to key stakeholders.
  

This position reports to the Senior Director, Appraisal Innovation Operations but works closely with the entirety of the CX Operational teams as well as finance, sales and product.
  

On occasion, this role will be asked to provide support and leadership to projects within the ASG and additional Clear Capital divisions as needed.
### **What You Will Work On**


* Lead requirements gathering by facilitating stakeholder sessions to elicit, analyze, and document operational needs
* Define project scope and business objectives to ensure alignment with long\-term strategy
* Validate delivered solutions against business needs through user story creation and acceptance criteria
* Provide analytical support to teams engaged in ongoing performance improvement initiatives
	+ Weekly internal reporting: Performance, financials and escalations
	+ On\-demand customer requests for custom analysis
	+ Coverage analysis of appraiser and broker panels
* Provide Analyst support to CX Organization to build accurate and robust business justifications for system enhancement requests, analyze performance trends.
* Building dashboards and reports using tools like google sheets, google slides and quicksight
* Effectively communicate analysis, data and recommendations to senior leadership and other CX stakeholders
### **Who We Are Looking For**


* 2\-4 years of experience as a Junior Analyst, QA Analyst, Data Analyst, or Operations Associate; demonstrated exposure to project support, documentation, and reporting.
* Strong data analysis skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proven ability in influencing cross\-functional stakeholders and guiding project direction
* Demonstrated strong work ethic
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills to create data with little direction
* Demonstrated ability to manage through change and adapt to a changing environment
* Strong history of mentoring and developing employees
* Ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy while managing multiple complex projects


**Additional Qualifications**


* Microsoft/Google Experience
* Deep Excel/Sheets Experience to perform helpful analysis for the business
* P\&L experience
* Strong business acumen
### **What You Can Expect**

* Compensation: The base salary for this position ranges from $92,000 \- $115,000 annually, depending on your location, experience, and qualifications. Additional compensation offerings include a company profit\-sharing bonus program, communication stipends, and referral bonuses.
* Inclusive benefits package offering:  

Comprehensive medical, dental, and company paid vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, voluntary life and AD\&D insurance options, voluntary supplemental insurances for accident, critical illness, and legal services, paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays, employee assistance and wellness programs, company paid short term disability coverage, company contributions to health saving funds (with participation in the high deductible health plan. We offer company\-paid access to Galileo for virtual primary care and Rula for virtual mental health resources.
* Through our Anniversary Program, we celebrate the meaningful milestones and long tenure that reflect how much we value your contributions and commitment to our team.  

Career and skill development resources to help advance your career and personal growth.  

A mission\-driven environment where your work makes a measurable
* impact on the real estate industry.

### **What We Value**

* Wherever it Leads, Whatever it Takes® \- No matter how remote, complex, or unexpected. Our commitment never wavers.
* Hire NICE people \- Skills can be taught but character shines through. We seek those who bring integrity, kindness, and grit.
* Lift others up \- We lead with empathy and strive to improve the lives of those around us.
* Sweat the details \- Excellence lives in the little things. Getting it just so is how we make a big impact.
* Raise the bar \- We don’t settle for industry standards, we redefine them.


About Us



Clear Capital is a national real estate analytics, data solutions and valuation technology company with a simple purpose: to build confidence in real estate decisions to strengthen communities and improve lives. Our goal is to provide customers with a complete understanding of nearly every U.S. property through our AI\-driven analytics, data solutions, valuation services and automated appraisal review platforms. Our commitment to excellence \- wherever it leads, whatever it takes® \- is embodied by our team members across our brands and has remained steadfast in this pursuit since our first order in 2001\.

**Department:** Call Center

**Location:** Remote

**Reports To:** Call Center Manager


 Installation Made Easy (“IME”) provides software and process management that enable retailers and contractors to offer installed home improvements to homeowners in a convenient, consistent, and affordable manner. IME senior management has over 100 years of retail management and home improvement industry experience.


The Call Center Representative is responsible for delivering exceptional customer service and support to customers and Providers through inbound and outbound calls in a fully virtual environment. This role serves as the voice of the company and requires professionalism, accuracy, and strong communication skills. **Key Daily Responsibilities:**

**Customer Support \& Communication**

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**


Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence\-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence\-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.


Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

* *Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)*
* *Virtual pharmacist\-led or clinician\-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps*
* *Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies*

**This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:**

* **SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)**
* **SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)**
* **MTM (Medication Therapy Management)**
* **TCC (Total Cost of Care)**
* **Polypharmacy**


During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick\-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.


As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow\-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission\-driven, team\-oriented, joyful culture.

 **Responsibilities and Impact will include:**

* Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns
* Supports cost of care efforts by reaching out to providers and members to offer lower cost alternative medication options
* Manages an assigned caseload which may require provider, pharmacy, and/or member follow\-up to address medication recommendations, concerns, or questions
* Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow\-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation
* Helps members navigate their Devoted Health benefits

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties
jobs.description:
**About A.C.T.I.O.N.**



A.C.T.I.O.N. is a proposed community\-wide overdose prevention initiative that will expand access to FDA\-approved opioid overdose reversal medications (OORMs), community training, and treatment referral pathways across the twelve counties of Alabama's 4th Congressional District (Lauderdale, Colbert, Franklin, Marion, Lamar, Fayette, Walker, Winston, Cullman, Marshall, DeKalb, and Blount). This position is contingent upon receipt of federal SAMHSA grant funding.



**Position Summary**



The Community Health Worker (CHW) for Cluster 1 is responsible for opioid overdose reversal medication (OORM) distribution, overdose\-recognition and response training, and referral follow\-up within Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties, working in close partnership with the cluster's designated community partner organization. This locally embedded, field\-based role requires strong ties to the assigned counties.



**Key Responsibilities**



* Distribute FDA\-approved OORMs (naloxone and nalmefene) to bystanders, community sectors, and rural first responders within Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties.
* Deliver overdose\-recognition, response, and OORM\-administration training to both traditional partners (healthcare providers, pharmacies, EMS, school systems) and non\-traditional community sectors (e.g., gas station attendants, motel staff, retail employees, postal workers).
* Train local Training\-of\-Trainers cohorts to extend the training curriculum further into the community.
* Support referral and linkage follow\-up for individuals identified through prevention or overdose response activities, in coordination with the Program Coordinator/Data Lead.
* Maintain local relationships with the cluster's designated community partner, healthcare providers, pharmacies, faith\-based organizations, and schools.
* Complete required data collection instruments accurately and submit them to the Program Coordinator/Data Lead on the required schedule.
* Participate in the Local Community Prevention Collaborative and community\-facing outreach and distribution events.

**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in public health, social work, or a related field
* Local, rural\-based residency or strong ties to Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties, with community trust and lived familiarity with the area.
* Community health worker certification or equivalent lived or professional experience preferred.
* Strong local community relationships and the trust of area residents.
* Ability to complete Aletheia House's overdose\-recognition and naloxone\-administration training during onboarding (provided).
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within the assigned counties for distribution and training visits.
* Comfortable with basic data entry and reporting tools.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Aletheia House is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Candidates are selected based on merit and qualifications only.


**Schedule**



Monday\-Friday 9:00am\-5:00pm; occasional weekends and evenings for community events

jobs.title: Medical Intelligence Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking a driven and professional **Medical Intelligence Operations Analyst** to work on the US PACOM Command Surgeon’s Decision Support Team (DST). This position serves as the DST's senior medical\-intelligence specialist and primary interface with the US PACOM J2 intelligence enterprise regarding biosurveillence and related threats. The Analyst assesses foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological threats, biosecurity, biosafety, and related scientific developments. General all\-source experience without medical\-intelligence expertise is insufficient. Assigned to the PACOM Joint Intelligence Operations Center (JIOC), the position directly supports Command Surgeon (J07\), receives functional priorities from J07 through established contract channels, operates with project and technical oversight from Science and Technology Division (S\&T) \- J85, and reports administratively to the Amentum Project Lead.

**Essential Responsibilities**:

* Conduct medical\-intelligence analysis of worldwide health, medical, biological, biosecurity, and biosafety issues affecting the US PACOM AOR.
* Assess foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological warfare and bioterrorism threats, medical research, and scientific or technological developments.
* Fuse classified intelligence, medical reporting, scientific research, public\-health data, open sources, and partner reporting.
* Identify indicators, trends, anomalies, intelligence gaps, and implications for force health, readiness, and mission risk.
* Maintain awareness of US PACOM plans and operations; assess and forecast medical\-intelligence implications for current and anticipated missions.
* Serve as the DST interface with J2, DIA, the National Center for Medical Intelligence, and other Intelligence Community organizations.
* Produce assessments and briefings consistent with analytic standards, classification requirements, and dissemination controls.
* Provide findings to the Operations Planner for integration with epidemiology, Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosive (CBRNE) analysis, Force Health Protection, and operational plans.
* Participate in intelligence exchanges, working groups, exercises, and bilateral or multilateral biosurveillance activities.
* Test the Biosurveillance Information Platform and provide intelligence\-specific findings for Military Utility Assessments and recommendations.
* Translate intelligence\-user needs into requirements for technical feeds, dashboards, alerts, and workflows; coding is not required.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree, or equivalent education, intelligence training, military education, and directly related experience.
* Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to complete a polygraph examination if required. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Top\-Secret Clearance.
* Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible intelligence analysis, including at least 2 years conducting medical intelligence analysis.
* Medical\-intelligence experience involving health threats, foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological threats, or scientific and technical intelligence.
* Working knowledge of DIA analytic tradecraft, product standards, and style requirements and Intelligence Community Directives 203 and 206\.
* Ability to fuse medical, scientific, and intelligence information into products suitable for senior Department of War (DoW) leaders.
* Familiarity with military planning and ability to work with military planners; strong analytic writing, briefing, and classified\-information handling skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced Degree.
* Medical\-intelligence experience within the last 5 years; Military Intelligence Integrated Database (MIDB)/Machine\-Assisted Analytic Rapid\-Repository System (MARS) or comparable database experience.
* Education or professional experience in medicine, biology, epidemiology, public health, microbiology, or another health field.
* Combatant Command, JIOC, DIA, National Center for Medical Intelligence (NCMI), biosafety, or biological\-research\-facility experience.
* Indo\-Pacific experience and familiarity with AI\-enabled tools, Maven Smart System, or biosurveillance platforms.
* Deep understanding of global infectious diseases, endemic pathogens, biosafety/biosecurity standards (BSL\-3/BSL\-4\), and emerging dual\-use biotechnology.
* Thorough knowledge of State/Non\-State biological warfare (BW) doctrine, weaponization methods, and bioterrorism threat vectors.
* Familiarity with foreign medical infrastructure, health surveillance capabilities, and foreign military medical readiness.
* Mastery of ICD 203 (Analytic Standards) and ICD 206 (Sourcing Requirements \& Dissemination).
* Familiarity with the National Center for Medical Intelligence (NCMI) operations, reporting workflows, and production frameworks.
* Working knowledge of Joint Staff and Combatant Command (CCMD) intelligence directorate structures (specifically J2, J3/JOC, J07, and J85\).
* Working knowledge of public health infrastructure, endemic disease landscapes, and biosecurity policies across the Indo\-Pacific Area of Responsibility (AOR).
* Familiarity with regional adversaries' S\&T modernization efforts and state\-sponsored life sciences research programs.
* Understanding of Force Health Protection (FHP) policies, Joint Operational Planning Process (JOPP), and how medical intelligence integrates into OPLANs/CONPLANs.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

HIRING SALARY RANGE: $155K \- $180K (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant internal equity, and alignment with market data.)

Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.


  
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that.


But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.


We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.


At Headway, we're building a new mental healthcare system from the ground up—one that's accessible, effective, and built to scale. Providers on Headway are responsible for their own coding and documentation, and many are new to billing insurance in private practice. We review that documentation against clinical documentation standards — and when a provider has questions about what came back, someone needs to give them a clear, accurate answer they can act on. That's this role.


As a **Senior Clinical \& Coding Operations Associate**, you're the coding and billing expert providers reach when they have questions about their documentation review results. You'll interpret those results, determine whether a finding is actually correct, and explain what it means in language a clinician can act on. You'll also be the person who catches it when a review result is wrong — and gets it fixed.


**A Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification is required**. All care on Headway is outpatient behavioral health, delivered in person or virtually.


**This is not an auditing role, and it is not a production coding role.** A separate team performs the documentation audits; you won't be auditing charts or coding claims. You'll apply the same depth of coding knowledge to a different problem — getting providers to the right answer, and making sure the guidance they receive is correct.


**You Will:**


* Interpret behavioral health documentation and coding review results (ICD\-10\-CM and CPT) and translate them into clear, actionable provider education and feedback
* Determine whether a flagged finding is accurate — confirming genuine documentation and coding errors, and identifying findings that were flagged incorrectly so they can be corrected and escalated
* Serve as a subject matter expert by answering provider and internal\-team questions on behavioral health coding and documentation (ICD\-10\-CM and CPT) and billing findings
* Deliver clear, accurate, and empathetic responses to providers through our support channels (e.g., Zendesk)
* Contribute to provider education efforts, including drafting content, identifying documentation gaps, and advising on documentation standards
* Partner with our Customer Experience (CX) team to build knowledge base content and resources that help resolve more questions without direct SME support
* Provide insights on coding trends, identify risk areas, and recommend improvements to tooling, process, and training
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners on initiatives that improve the provider audit\-support experience
* Stay current with evolving coding guidelines, payer rules, and industry standards through continuing education and independent learning

**You’d be a great fit if….**


* Have a CPC certification (required) and 2\-3 years of experience in outpatient or professional\-services coding, ideally within a behavioral health setting
* Possess a strong grasp of ICD\-10\-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines and the documentation requirements
* Communicate clearly and empathetically, especially when educating providers or discussing sensitive feedback
* Have the ability to balance supportive coaching and enforcing provider policies regarding payer standards and compliance regulations
* Hold a CPMA certification (nice to have)
* Can independently reach the correct coding and documentation conclusion on a behavioral health note and defend it — including disagreeing with a review result when the documentation supports you
* Are energized by making providers and frontline teams self\-sufficient, rather than by reviewing charts
* Previously educated providers on medical decision making (MDM) for outpatient Evaluation and Management (E/M) services
* Bring a high level of attention to detail and comfort working independently in a fast\-paced, digital environment
* Are tech\-savvy: you can navigate Google Workspace, Zoom, and EMR platforms—or you're excited to learn
* Are energized by working cross\-functionally and driving quality at scale in a tech\-forward setting

**Compensation and Benefits:**


The expected base pay range for this position is $76,160 \- $112,000 based on a variety

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Operations Manager — Financially SMART**

**About Financially SMART**

Financially SMART is a fractional CFO and outsourced accounting firm built exclusively for wealth management firms and RIAs. We serve advisory firms through a pod\-based model — each client is supported by a dedicated bookkeeper, senior accountant, and advisor — and we pair that service with FinSights AI, our proprietary financial analytics platform that gives clients real\-time dashboards, benchmarking, and AI\-driven commentary.

We've grown to a 13\-person team in under three years. Now we need someone to make sure the machine runs as well as the people in it.

**The Role**

The Operations Manager is the connective tissue of the firm. You'll own how work moves through Financially SMART — making sure every client deliverable goes out on time and to standard, our CRM reflects reality, and our team operates from one playbook instead of many. You'll report directly to the Founder and partner closely with our Director of Finance, accounting pods, and client advisors.

This is a builder role. You'll inherit a strong team and good systems, and your job is to tighten them, connect them, and scale them.

What You'll Do

**Service delivery \& deliverables oversight**

* Track and manage the monthly delivery calendar across all clients — closes, financial packages, reports, dashboards, and forecasts
* Monitor pod workloads and deadlines; spot bottlenecks early and reallocate or escalate before clients feel it
* Own quality\-control checkpoints so every deliverable meets the firm standard before it goes out
* Drive adoption of standardized processes, including our month\-end close checklist, across every pod

**CRM \& workflow management (FinancialCents)**

* Serve as the owner and administrator of our CRM/workflow system
* Build and maintain recurring task templates, workflows, and client records so the system is the single source of truth
* Hold the team accountable to keeping tasks, statuses, and notes current
* Produce weekly operational reporting: deliverable status, overdue items, capacity, and client health

**Firm operations \& alignment**

* Run internal operating cadences — weekly team syncs, pod check\-ins, and status reviews
* Document and improve SOPs for client onboarding, offboarding, and core service workflows
* Coordinate new client onboarding from signed engagement through first deliverable
* Support hiring and onboarding of new team members, including offshore staff
* Identify gaps between sales, service, and FinSights, and close them
* Act as a point of escalation for operational and client\-service issues

What You Bring

* 4\+ years in operations, practice management, or service delivery — ideally at an accounting firm, outsourced accounting/CAS practice, or professional services firm
* Proven experience owning a CRM or practice management tool (FinancialCents, Karbon, Canopy, TaxDome, Asana, or similar)
* A systems mindset — you see a recurring problem and build the process that fixes it permanently
* Strong organization and follow\-through across dozens of moving deadlines
* Comfortable holding a team accountable with clarity and respect
* Working knowledge of accounting workflows (month\-end close, financial reporting); QuickBooks Online familiarity is a plus
* Clear, concise communicator, both written and verbal

**Bonus points**

* Experience in or around wealth management, RIAs, or financial services
* Experience managing or coordinating remote and offshore teams
* Background scaling a firm through a growth phase

Why Financially SMART

* Direct access to the Founder and real influence over how the firm is built
* A growing, niche firm with a clear specialty and a proprietary tech platform
* Fully remote team
* \[Benefits: health, PTO, 401(k), etc.]

To Apply

Submit your resume and a short note describing a process or system you built that made a team run better — what was broken, what you changed, and the result.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $72,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

The IT department at CrowdStrike is at the forefront of enabling our company's rapid growth and technological innovation. * 7\+ years of experience in program management or Operations with a track record of building and improving processes in a technology, product, AI, or other fast\-paced environments and delivering measurable results.
* Ability to connect people, processes, tools, and data into practical operating mechanisms that scale across teams and stakeholder groups.
* Experience creating content that turns complex operational and program information into clear executive\-level narratives.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to align stakeholders, facilitate forums, clarify decisions, and drive execution without relying solely on formal authority.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, AI platforms, and common enterprise AI use cases, with demonstrated curiosity and drive to apply AI to enable new ways of working.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a continuous\-improvement mindset with the ability to move quickly in an evolving environment.

jobs.title: Litigation Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Story**
-------------


TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end\-to\-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world\-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.


Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.


We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast\-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

 **The Opportunity**


The Litigation Operations Manager is responsible for the operational execution of Top Dog Law's litigation function across all active states. This role serves as the primary implementation layer between firm leadership and state\- level litigation teams. A core responsibility of this role is the direct oversight, training, and accountability of Litigation Team Leads in each state, ensuring uniformity in how cases are managed from litigation through trial.

**What You Will Own**

**Team Lead Oversight \& Development**

* Directly supervise Litigation Team Leads across all active states (FL, GA, MS, AZ, LA, NY, TN, IL)
* Implement onboarding and ongoing training programs for all Team Leads, ensuring mastery of firm SOPs, Filevine workflows, phase movement standards, and performance expectations
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones and performance reviews with Team Leads to identify gaps, address concerns, and drive professional development
* Serve as the primary escalation point for Team Leads on case\-level operational issues
* Identify and develop high\-performing paralegals and litigation staff for Team Lead succession

**Litigation Operations Implementation**

* Implement and enforce firm\-wide litigation SOPs across all states, adapting for state\-specific court rules and procedural requirements
* Monitor compliance with phase timing benchmarks from filing through trial; escalate bottlenecks to the Regional Operations team.
* Oversee daily operational workflows including task management, deadline tracking, court filing compliance, and case phase movement
* Partner with Team Leads to ensure caseload assignments are balanced against capacity and case complexity
* Coordinate cross\-state operational initiatives, ensuring consistent execution regardless of jurisdiction

**Training \& Standards**

* Design and deliver litigation\-specific training for Team Leads and litigation staff on Filevine, case management protocols, court procedures, and SOL compliance.
* Maintain and update litigation SOPs, playbooks, and reference materials as court rules, firm processes, or case management systems evolve.
* Facilitate regular Team Lead meetings to share best practices, surface operational challenges, and reinforce firm standards
* Support the rollout of new tools, systems, and workflows ensuring Team Leads are fully trained and held accountable to adoption

**Data \& Reporting**

* Monitor litigation performance metrics across states using Filevine and BigQuery dashboards
* Prepare regular operational reports for Law Firm Operations on phase velocity, caseload health, task completion rates, and Team Lead performance
* Identify trends and anomalies in case data and initiate corrective action at the Team Lead level before issues escalate

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 5\+ years of experience in personal injury litigation operations, legal operations management, or a senior paralegal leadership role
* Prior experience supervising or training litigation staff across multiple offices or jurisdictions strongly preferred
* Deep familiarity with litigation case management platforms; Filevine experience a plus
* Strong working knowledge of personal injury litigation workflows — from filing through trial — across multiple states
* Demonstrated ability to implement SOPs, hold teams accountable to standards, and drive performance through others
* Comfortable working with data and performance metrics; ability to read dashboards and translate findings into operational action
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and firm leadership

 **Who Thrives Here (Core Values)**


We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

* **Embrace Change:** Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
* **Committed:** You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
* **No\-Ego Energy:** Positive, professional, and solutions\-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
* **Ownership:** You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
* **Fast \& Hungry:** You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

 **What We Offer**

* Base Salary: $105,000 \- $125,000, commensurate with experience
* Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
* Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

 **Equal Opportunity Employer**


We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex

AEDIT is a beauty technology company transforming how consumers discover, evaluate, shop for, and access aesthetic treatments and products through trusted content, proprietary technology, AI\-powered tools, ecommerce, and strategic partnerships.

jobs.title: Sales Operations and Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Have you been looking for a company that you can get behind and feel good about the impact it has on sustainability and recycling efforts? Quest is a full\-service environmental consulting and management group supporting the efforts of Fortune 500 companies seeking to maximize profits and mitigate risks and minimize their ecological footprints.

If you want an opportunity where your efforts make an impact, Quest has an opportunity for you. The ideal person must be able to multi\-task, work independently and have strong attention to detail while being able to collaboratively communicate across departments.

**Why Work at Quest?**  
First off, we practice what we preach. We focus every day on recycling, reusing and repurposing where we can, and being socially responsible.

Finally, we are just a modern, FUN and collaborative work environment. We’re a smaller company that provides opportunities for employees to advance within the company, so there is always room to grow. We offer a casual business environment (so, you can wear jeans), great incentives and rewards with a quarterly recognition program.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Sales Operations \& Implementation Manager is responsible for aligning strategic sales initiatives with operational execution, guiding opportunities through the sales pipeline to implementation and live launch. This role combines sales operations support for the National Sales Managers (NSMs) with hands\-on project management of new client and wallet share implementations, ensuring stage\-gate requirements are met before deals progress and that established deadlines are met at each pipeline stage through launch.

The Manager oversees sales processes, CRM utilization, lead board maintenance, sales enablement, and reporting functions, and serves as the primary point of coordination between Sales, Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, and Key Accounts throughout the sales\-to\-launch lifecycle.

This role requires strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation timelines, along with the cross\-functional relationship\-building skills to keep deals and launches on track across Sales, Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, Key Accounts, and Operations.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION**

* **Sales Process \& CRM Management:** Supports the SVP of Sales and Marketing in designing and maintaining SOPs for all sales activities, leads onboarding and CRM training for new NSMs, and builds and optimizes dashboards for executive reporting, individual sales rep performance, and pipeline/funnel tracking.
* **Lead Management \& Sales Enablement:** Owns and manages the sales lead board, partnering with Marketing on lead generation strategy and tracking lead performance and conversion metrics. Leads sales enablement efforts — training, tools, and resources — that support NSM effectiveness, and partners closely with NSMs to prioritize outreach and target account alignment.
* **Pipeline Stage\-Gate Ownership:** Establishes and maintains stage\-gate criteria for each phase of the sales pipeline. Acts as the opportunity validator, ensuring required documentation and approvals — including signed MNDA, signed LOA where applicable, site lists, and invoices/spend data — are complete before an opportunity advances to the next stage.
* **Vendor Pricing \& Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Partners closely with Business Solutions and Vendor Relations to ensure vendor pricing and bids are received on timeto support proposal and closing timelines, and coordinates with Key Accounts and other stakeholders to confirm deal readiness at each stage gate.
* **Implementation \& Launch Project Management:** Serves as project manager for new client and wallet share implementations, owning the timeline from signed contract through live launch. Builds and maintains implementation project plans, establishing milestones, deadlines, and owners for each workstream, and proactively identifies and resolves risks to keep launches on track.
* **Client Handoff \& Launch Support:** Coordinates cross\-functionally with Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, Key Accounts, and Operations throughout implementation, and confirms a smooth transition to Key Accounts and Operations post\-launch to ensure continuity of service and a positive client experience.
* **Cross\-Departmental Collaboration:** Actively participates in internal meetings related to sales performance, process optimization, and strategic initiatives, and contributes to internal enablement by sharing insights, best practices, and feedback across teams.

**ROLE COMPETENCIES**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Implementation, Project Management, or a related field.
* Strong project management skills, with proven ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation timelines and cross\-functional workstreams.
* Proven ability to manage and improve sales systems, processes, and cross\-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated success in coaching, supporting, and guiding team members in a high\-performance sales environment.
* Proficient with CRM, sales engagement, and project management platforms/tools.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data\-driven recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to influence and collaborate across departments, including Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, and Key Accounts.
* Experience developing SOPs, performance dashboards, and sales/implementation reports for both executive and team\-level use.
* Skilled in lead management processes, pipeline optimization, and stage\-gate/deal qualification strategies.
* Highly organized with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with RFP identification/qualification and vendor pricing or bid processes

jobs.title: Program Launch Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convergent Research**
-----------------------------



Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We design, launch, and support mission\-driven, time\-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks.



FROs are designed to tackle the kinds of problems that benefit from unusual levels of focus, coordination, and scale. Convergent provides the operational backbone that allows FRO teams to move quickly—from legal formation, funding, hiring, finance, and governance to partnerships, communications, and operational systems.



We’ve now taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026\. And we’re not slowing down.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Turning an ambitious scientific idea into a functioning organization requires a lot more than good science.



There are entities to form, teams to hire, systems to stand up, funders and partners to coordinate, decisions to make, and approximately one million details that need to happen in the right order. At the same time, the founders doing this work are often building an organization for the first time.



That’s where you come in.



As our **Program Launch Manager**, you’ll sit at the center of the FRO lifecycle. You’ll help promising scientific projects become functioning organizations while also running large\-scale founder programs that develop the next generation of FROs.



You’ll be part project manager, part operator, and part trusted partner. One minute you might be building a launch plan across legal, finance, people, and IT. The next, you’re helping a scientist understand an unfamiliar operational decision, chasing down a dependency that could delay launch, or making sure a founder residency participant has what they need to make progress.



This isn’t a traditional project\-management or account\-management role. Our systems and playbooks are still evolving, and every FRO is different. You’ll need to bring structure without creating bureaucracy, keep things moving without losing sight of the people involved, and turn what we learn from every launch into a better system for the next one.



### **You Are (Skills):**

* **A project manager who can make ambiguity actionable.** Give you a complicated goal with multiple teams, unclear dependencies, and a moving timeline, and you can turn it into a practical plan. You know who owns what, what needs to happen next, where the risks are, and which decisions are holding everything else up.
* **Operationally rigorous.** You notice the details that matter. You keep accurate records, follow through reliably, and know that a small operational gap today can become a much larger problem three weeks from now.
* **People\-centered and emotionally intelligent.** Launching an organization can be exciting, confusing, stressful, and occasionally all three before lunch. You build trust quickly, meet people where they are, and know when to coach, facilitate, advise, push, or simply listen.
* **A confident, clear, proactive communicator.** You can run an effective meeting, write a concise status update, ask the uncomfortable\-but\-important question, and translate complicated processes into something another human can actually understand. You’re equally comfortable working with scientists, founders, executives, vendors, funders, and functional specialists.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You’ve worked somewhere entrepreneurial—perhaps a startup, nonprofit, consultancy, research organization, or similar environment—where not every process came with an instruction manual. You bring structure while recognizing that the right answer may be different for every FRO.
* **A fan of functional systems.** After doing something manually for the fifth time, you start wondering whether there’s a better way. You like turning bespoke work into useful processes, templates, documentation, and operating rhythms—and you’re interested in using automation and AI thoughtfully when they can make those systems better.
* **A great juggler.** Multiple launches, founder programs, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines don’t scare you. You can manage several workstreams at once, adjust when priorities change, and keep things moving without adding unnecessary process.

### **You Will (Duties):**

* **Lead FRO launches.** You’ll own the day\-to\-day coordination of one or more FRO launches, bringing together Convergent’s legal, finance, people, compliance, procurement, IT, fundraising, communications, and leadership teams. You’ll build and manage launch plans from proposal approval and funding commitment through entity formation, operational activation, team onboarding, and early FRO execution. You’ll run launch meetings, track decisions and dependencies, surface risks early, resolve blockers, and help coordinate launches across both U.S. and international contexts.
* **Run founder programs.** You’ll own the operational delivery of FRO Founder Residencies, open calls, Launchpad programs, and other partner\-led initiatives—from planning and participant onboarding through programming, selection, and closeout. You’ll coordinate program design, participant experience, and internal operational work while providing thoughtful, high\-touch support to founders and teams.
* **Be a trusted partner to FRO founders.** You’ll serve as a consistent and responsive point of contact for founders and FRO leaders during launch and early operations. You’ll help them understand Convergent’s operating model, systems, decision rights, governance expectations, and available support. You’ll advocate for their needs while also helping them navigate the realities of building a new organization.

* Provide project coordination and administrative support across Contracting \& Analytics client engagements and internal initiatives.

**Engagement Type:** Temporary, W2, with possible conversion to a permanent, full\-time Operations Associate role at the end of the term

**Position Overview**


Indagare is hiring a Temporary Operations Associate for an initial three\-month term, with a strong possibility of conversion to a permanent, full\-time role based on performance and business need. This person's primary focus will be our Finance x Operations initiative – a cross\-functional effort to modernize and tighten up several of our core operational and financial processes – working under the direct oversight of the Senior Director of Operations. As capacity allows, this role will also grow into supporting partner and supplier\-facing communications as well as cross\-functional projects with other internal departments.

Document the process and train relevant stakeholders on the new workflow.

Define and finalize a clear write\-off policy and an aging/escalation process for outstanding receivables.

*Documentation Sprint*

Help structure, write, and organize SOPs so they are consistent, easy to find, and easy to maintain going forward.

*Expense Report Process Review*

Identify and recommend any further refinements needed for accuracy, compliance, and ease of use.

* Track open issues, coordinate across stakeholders, and keep the initiative moving toward the finish line.
* Cross\-Departmental Accountability
* Ensure meeting notes and action items are distributed promptly and clearly across all workstreams.
* Track deadlines and proactively hold team members accountable to their commitments.

*End\-of\-Year Sentiment \& Impact Review*


Conduct a retrospective/sentiment review at the end of the engagement (or calendar year) to assess what was accomplished.


Measure and summarize impact against relevant KPIs, and capture lessons learned for future process work.

**What You'll Do —** Supplier \& Cross\-Functional Support (Growth Area)


As the Finance x Operations project progresses and bandwidth allows, this role will expand to include:

* Serving as a point of contact liaising with suppliers on behalf of Operations, coordinating communications and following up on open items.
* Supporting cross\-functional projects with other internal departments beyond Finance and Operations, as priorities arise.

* Exceptional project management skills — the ability to organize multiple concurrent workstreams, track details, and reliably drive projects to completion.
* Confidence and polish working with, and managing up to, senior leadership; comfortable pushing timelines and holding stakeholders accountable.
* A proactive, ownership\-oriented mindset — someone who identifies what needs to happen next and moves it forward without waiting to be asked.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for documentation, process write\-ups, and stakeholder updates.
* Comfort working across ambiguity and shifting priorities as the role grows from a defined project into broader cross\-functional support.
* 1–3\+ years of relevant work experience in operations, project management, finance, or a related field; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Familiarity with financial processes (AR/collections, expense management, vendor/contractor payments) and tools like Salesforce or NetSuite is a plus, but not required — we're prioritizing project management and leadership\-facing skills over specific tool expertise.

**Engagement Details**

* This is a temporary, W2 role, not initially benefits\-eligible, unless and until converted to permanent employment.
* Primary focus for the engagement is the Finance x Operations project described above, with growing scope into supplier liaison and cross\-departmental project work as capacity allows.
* Performance and fit will be evaluated on an ongoing basis, with a formal check\-in near the end of the term to discuss extension, conversion to a permanent Operations Associate role, or conclusion of the engagement.

**Project Manager (Technical)**
-------------------------------


**Location:** Remote US


**Who We Are:**
---------------



Enterra Solutions is introducing the world's top brands and market leaders to true enterprise intelligence. Powered by our groundbreaking Enterra Autonomous Decision Science™ Platform, we're delivering enterprise\-wide optimization and decision\-making to help businesses best achieve their most complex goals. We're providing real human insights to facilitate smarter, faster market moves. And we're turning unknowns into opportunities for unprecedented growth and agility. All with next\-level speed, accuracy, autonomy, and continuous learning. We're shaping the future \- join a dynamic, collaborative team where your contributions drive real impact.


**Overview**



The Project Manager (PM) oversees the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, client expectations, and quality standards. The PM serves as a central point of communication between stakeholders and project teams, manages resources effectively, mitigates risks, and drives continuous process improvement to maximize the success and profitability of projects.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


* Define project scope, deliverables, tasks, timelines, and charters; develop comprehensive project plans in MS Project and Excel aligned with client and organizational requirements.
* Monitor progress against plans, adjust timelines and resources as needed, ensure high\-quality delivery, and manage project closure activities including documentation, postmortems, and lessons learned.
* Allocate tasks, assign backup resources, provide guidance and direction to team members, and ensure efficient utilization of internal and external project resources.
* Identify root causes of issues, develop effective resolutions, and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans to prevent project delays or obstacles.
* Serve as the central point of contact for project teams, clients, and internal stakeholders; provide regular updates, schedule and facilitate meetings, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Manage project\-related Teams sites, PMO meetings, and documentation; maintain organized and accurate records of all project communications and materials.
* Perform other related duties as required, including coordination with external stakeholders, vendors, or partners.

**Your Skill\-set:**
--------------------


**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's of Master's degree in business, project management, or a related field.
* Experience delivering technology solutions within the Consumer\-Packaged Goods (CPG) industry required, ideally within trade promotion management (TPM).
* 3–5 years of experience managing technical client\-facing projects within the CPG industry, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment.

jobs.title: Freelance Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

**You are organized, driven, and thrive in an ownership role.**  

  

The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary point of contact and gateway into the studio for a defined set of clients, including Syneos Communications agencies and Syneos Health Clinical departments. Acting as a holistic business partner, the Senior Program Manager ensures the studio delivers on client needs and expectations. This role is accountable for ensuring overall client satisfaction. The Senior Program Manager reports directly to the Director, Program Management.  

  

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for defining project parameters, contributing to creative ideation sessions, and participating in tactical recommendation brainstorming. Once project parameters are aligned between the client and the studio, the Senior Program Manager leads and oversees the project from start to finish, including budget development, timeline creation, and management of deliverable routing. The Senior Program Manager should possess deep knowledge of the creative process and have experience with print production.  

  

This role partners closely with the studio teams and serves as the primary lead for one our internal communication teams, ensuring that work is routed appropriately to necessary stakeholders. The Senior Program Manager ensures that the Creative team is fully integrated into the workflow and redirects relevant projects to them as needed.  

  

**Client and Business Management*** Serves as the studio’s lead representative, ensuring client expectations are consistently met.
* Builds, maintains, and nurtures strong relationships with key stakeholders across disciplines.
* Acts as an advocate for the studio by continually building organizational awareness of its value, including coordinating capability presentations, and proactively promoting and recommending studio services as appropriate.
* Handles challenges professionally and navigates disagreements diplomatically to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Represents the studio in new business opportunities.
* Acts as the primary escalation point for quality issues, workflow gaps, or performance concerns, and partners with studio leadership to address concerns related to studio performance, personnel, or potential client issues.
* Responsible for hiring, training, and managing a team of direct reports, including conducting annual performance reviews and supporting career development.

  

**Intake**  

* Serves as the gatekeeper for all incoming projects, ensuring requests are clearly defined and include all necessary information (e.g., confirmed budgets, links, assets, requirements).
* Directs projects to the appropriate team or discipline lead (Content Production, Technology, etc.) who will assign resources accordingly.
* Represents the studio holistically during key milestones, including triage and intake meetings, project status meetings, project planning, scoping discussions, and RFP processes.

  

**Execution**  

* Develops project estimates, timelines, and resource plans based on a deep understanding of program management and client partnership trajectories.
* Manages the day\-to\-day workflow of deliverables in alignment with the approved scope of work.
* Defines the “how” and “when” of project delivery and empowers teams to meet shared expectations and goals.
* Oversees and manages project budgets through regular tracking, reporting, and proactive problem\-solving.
* Maintains deep knowledge of the creative development process and print production workflows.

  

**Key Competencies**  

* 5\-8 years of experience in program management, delivery operations, or studio/agency experience
* Strategic and inspiring leader
* Strong ability to manage multiple clients, projects, and priorities while proactively anticipating issues
* Anticipates and resolves issues with a proactive, solution\-oriented approach; skilled at de\-escalating situations and making confident decisions
* Brings hands\-on experience in print production
* Skilled at fostering strong team morale and creating an environment of open and honest dialogue
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Client\-facing professional with broad understanding of studio services
* Strong presentation, sales, and marketing capabilities
* Keen creative eye for quality control
* Team management experience
* Ability to operate effectively within an integrated, networked service model


The anticipated hourly rate for this position is $55\.00 \- $65\.00 but may vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role.

At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Program Manager, Digital**



Location: Remote, Eastern and Central time zones preferred

  


**Who We Are:**



Tuesday Health is a value\-based palliative care provider group dedicated to transforming serious illness and end\-of\-life care. We deliver goal\-centered care focused on alleviating physical symptoms and emotional stress for individuals and their caregivers. Our interdisciplinary care teams reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve quality of life wherever individuals call home. Through our leading\-edge care model, Tuesday Health is shaping the future of community\-based palliative care nationwide.

  


**The Role:**



Tuesday Health is seeking a **Program Manager, Digital** to own the execution, operational performance, and continued growth of myTuesday, our patient digital access offering. Through the myTuesday platform, Tuesday Health provides patients with network\-enabled tablets preloaded with our mobile app, helping patients stay connected to their care and engage with Tuesday Health digitally.



This is a program management role focused on the operations and infrastructure that support myTuesday. The Program Manager will be accountable for ensuring the program operates effectively, delivers against established goals, and is positioned to scale as our patient population grows.



As part of the Product organization, the Program Manager will work closely with Operations, Product, external vendors, and other cross\-functional partners to translate program strategy into effective execution. This person will maintain a clear view of program performance, anticipate operational needs, identify risks and opportunities, and drive issues through resolution.



This role is well suited for a strong operator who is highly organized, comfortable working across teams, and motivated by building the processes and operating discipline needed to deliver results at scale.

  


**Key responsibilities of this role may include:**


* Own the day\-to\-day execution and operational performance of the myTuesday program, maintaining visibility across device deployment, replacements, returns, inventory, and other workflows managed by our vendor partners.
* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day owner of key vendor relationships, establish clear expectations, monitor performance, address issues, and hold partners accountable for delivering against program needs.
* Translate program goals and priorities into operating plans, processes, and measurable actions in partnership with Product and Operations.
* Monitor inventory, utilization, and anticipated patient demand to forecast future needs, proactively address capacity risks, and ensure the program is prepared to support growth.
* Establish and maintain visibility into key measures of program health, including patient adoption and utilization, inventory, vendor performance, and operational effectiveness.
* Use program data and operational insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and drive actions that improve program performance and outcomes.
* Partner with Product and Operations to strengthen, standardize, document, and, where appropriate, automate the operational workflows that support myTuesday.
* Drive operational readiness for changes or expansion of the myTuesday program, ensuring teams, vendors, processes, and supporting resources are prepared for successful implementation.
* Identify operational issues and process gaps, determine appropriate next steps, and coordinate across teams to drive timely resolution.
* Periodically assist patients with device setup or troubleshooting, using direct patient feedback and experience to identify opportunities to improve program operations and the patient experience.
* Support additional program management and cross\-functional initiatives within the Product organization based on organizational priorities.

* Bachelor's degree required, preferably in business, healthcare administration, operations, technology, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in program management, business operations, product operations, healthcare operations, project management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage programs, processes, or operational workstreams and drive work from planning through execution.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to identify operational gaps, develop practical solutions, and drive issues through resolution.
* Comfort working with data and reporting to evaluate program performance, identify trends, and inform operational decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to proactively identify what needs attention and drive work forward.
* Comfort working with technology and helping others navigate technical issues when needed.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment where priorities, programs, and processes continue to evolve.
* Experience in healthcare, digital health, healthcare technology, or technology\-enabled services is preferred.

* Competitive compensation, reflecting our commitment to attracting, retaining, and motivating the best talent in the industry
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, paid time off and holidays, employer 401(K) match, etc.
* Remote work with multiple onsite sessions each year to maximize collaboration and team building
